title: 人工智能的发展与应用

pairs.zh: 人工智能是一门让机器模仿人类思考、判断与学习的学问。
pairs.en: Artificial intelligence is a discipline that enables machines to mimic human thinking, judgment, and learning.

pairs.zh: 这门学科诞生于二十世纪五十年代的一次夏季研讨会上，学者们首次用这个词称呼它，并乐观预言，一代人之内，机器就能完成人类所能做的一切智力工作。
pairs.en: The field was born at a summer workshop in the 1950s, where scholars first used the term and optimistically predicted that within one generation machines would accomplish every intellectual task humans could do.

pairs.zh: 早在计算机刚出现的年代，就有学者提出一个著名的检验办法：让人隔着屏幕与两个对象对话，若分不清哪一个是人、哪一个是机器，便可认为机器具备了智能。
pairs.en: As early as the dawn of computers, scholars proposed a famous test: let a person converse with two entities through a screen, and if they cannot tell which is human and which is machine, the machine can be considered intelligent.

pairs.zh: 然而现实远比预想曲折。
pairs.en: Reality, however, proved far more tortuous than expected.

pairs.zh: 早期研究者试图把常识与推理规则一条条写进程序，造出所谓专家系统，它在特定领域内确实能像资深顾问一样给出建议，可一旦遇到规则之外的情况就频繁出错。
pairs.en: Early researchers tried to encode common sense and reasoning rules into programs one by one, building so-called expert systems; these did offer advice like seasoned consultants in narrow fields, but failed frequently whenever a situation fell outside the rules.

pairs.zh: 加上当时计算机算力薄弱、数据稀缺，研究几度陷入低谷，被人们称作两次寒冬。
pairs.en: Combined with weak computing power and scarce data at the time, research repeatedly sank into troughs, which people later called the two AI winters.

pairs.zh: 此后，国际象棋程序在二十世纪末战胜了世界冠军，让人们第一次意识到机器在复杂博弈上的潜力；
pairs.en: Later, at the end of the twentieth century, a chess program defeated the world champion, making people realize for the first time the potential of machines in complex games;

pairs.zh: 进入二十一世纪，围棋程序又以精妙的招式击败顶尖棋手，震动了整个棋界。
pairs.en: in the twenty-first century, a Go program defeated top players with exquisite moves, shaking the entire Go world.

pairs.zh: 真正的转折发生在二十一世纪前后。
pairs.en: The real turning point came around the beginning of the twenty-first century.

pairs.zh: 一方面，互联网让图片、文字、语音以前所未有的速度积累；
pairs.en: On the one hand, the Internet allowed images, text, and speech to accumulate at an unprecedented pace;

pairs.zh: 另一方面，芯片性能飞速提升，并行计算变得便宜。
pairs.en: on the other hand, chip performance improved rapidly and parallel computing became cheap.

pairs.zh: 于是，依靠海量数据与强大算力的机器学习逐渐成为主流。
pairs.en: As a result, machine learning, powered by massive data and strong computing power, gradually became the mainstream.

pairs.zh: 它不再要求人事先写死规则，而是让程序从例子中自己总结规律。
pairs.en: It no longer requires people to hard-code rules in advance; instead, it lets programs summarize patterns from examples on their own.

pairs.zh: 比如想让机器认出一只猫，开发者不必费力描述猫有尖耳朵、长尾巴，只要喂给它成千上万张标好猫与非猫的图片，机器在反复调整参数中就能学会区分。
pairs.en: For example, to teach a machine to recognize a cat, developers need not laboriously describe its pointed ears and long tail; they only need to feed it thousands of images labeled cat or not, and the machine learns to distinguish them by repeatedly adjusting its parameters.

pairs.zh: 在这之上，深度神经网络把模型做成许多层，每层抽取更抽象的特征，从边缘纹理到局部形状再到整个物体。
pairs.en: On top of this, deep neural networks stack models into many layers, each extracting more abstract features, from edges and textures to local shapes and then to whole objects.

pairs.zh: 二零一二年前后，凭借这种方法，机器在图像识别竞赛中的错误率骤降，整个人工智能行业随之被点燃。
pairs.en: Around 2012, with this approach, the error rate of machines in image recognition contests plummeted, igniting the entire AI industry.

pairs.zh: 今天，它已经悄悄走进日常生活。
pairs.en: Today, it has quietly entered everyday life.

pairs.zh: 清晨打开手机，语音助手能听懂自然语言并播报天气；
pairs.en: When you open your phone in the morning, a voice assistant understands natural language and reads out the weather;

pairs.zh: 导航软件根据实时路况重新规划路线；
pairs.en: navigation apps replan routes based on real-time traffic;

pairs.zh: 购物平台推荐你可能喜欢的商品；
pairs.en: shopping platforms recommend products you might like;

pairs.zh: 拍照时自动美化人脸、对焦主体。
pairs.en: and cameras automatically beautify faces and focus on subjects when taking photos.

pairs.zh: 在医院，辅助系统从肺部影像中筛出可疑结节，帮助医生更早发现病变；
pairs.en: In hospitals, assistive systems screen suspicious nodules from lung images, helping doctors detect diseases earlier;

pairs.zh: 在工厂，机械臂按视觉系统的指引精准装配零件；
pairs.en: in factories, robotic arms assemble parts precisely under the guidance of vision systems;

pairs.zh: 在银行，风控模型在几毫秒内判断一笔交易是否存在盗刷风险；
pairs.en: in banks, risk-control models judge within milliseconds whether a transaction carries the risk of fraud;

pairs.zh: 在农场，传感器配合算法判断土壤湿度与作物长势。
pairs.en: and on farms, sensors work with algorithms to gauge soil moisture and crop growth.

pairs.zh: 这些应用背后，是感知、决策、生成三类能力协同。
pairs.en: Behind these applications lies the coordination of three kinds of capability: perception, decision, and generation.

pairs.zh: 感知让机器看懂图像、听懂声音、读懂文字；
pairs.en: Perception lets machines see images, hear sounds, and read text;

pairs.zh: 决策让机器在多个方案中挑选收益最大的一个；
pairs.en: decision lets machines pick the most rewarding option among several alternatives;

pairs.zh: 生成则让机器写出文章、画出图片、谱出旋律、合成语音。
pairs.en: and generation lets machines write articles, draw pictures, compose melodies, and synthesize speech.

pairs.zh: 近年来，通用大模型把生成能力推向新高度。
pairs.en: In recent years, general-purpose large models have pushed generation capability to new heights.

pairs.zh: 大模型的养成也颇有讲究。
pairs.en: Raising a large model is something of a craft.

pairs.zh: 开发者先把海量文本、图片、代码喂给它，让它学习语言的规律与世界的常识，这一步叫做预训练；
pairs.en: Developers first feed it massive amounts of text, images, and code so that it learns the patterns of language and common knowledge about the world; this step is called pretraining;

pairs.zh: 接着再用人工标注的样例引导它按照人的习惯回答，这一步叫做微调；
pairs.en: then they guide it with human-annotated examples to answer in the way people habitually do; this step is called fine-tuning;

pairs.zh: 最后还要通过反馈，让它拒绝有害请求、减少胡说。
pairs.en: and finally, through feedback, they teach it to refuse harmful requests and to reduce fabrication.

pairs.zh: 经过这些环节，模型才能既博学又守规矩。
pairs.en: Only after these stages does the model become both knowledgeable and well-behaved.

pairs.zh: 它读过海量书籍与网页，能围绕一个问题写出条理清楚的回答，能把一段话翻译成多种语言，也能根据简单描述生成连贯长文。
pairs.en: Having read vast numbers of books and web pages, it can write clear, well-organized answers to a question, translate a passage into many languages, and generate coherent long texts from a simple description.

pairs.zh: 许多人用它整理会议纪要、草拟邮件、辅助编程，教师用它批改作业初稿，学生用它查找资料线索，程序员用它排查代码错误。
pairs.en: Many people use it to summarize meeting notes, draft emails, and assist with programming; teachers use it to review draft homework, students to find leads in their research, and programmers to debug code.

pairs.zh: 它还能同时处理文字、图像与声音，看到一张表格照片就能转写成可编辑文本，听到一段会议录音就能提炼出待办事项。
pairs.en: It can also handle text, images, and audio at once: given a photo of a table, it transcribes it into editable text, and given a meeting recording, it extracts action items.

pairs.zh: 在科研领域，模型帮助预测蛋白质结构、筛选药物分子、发现新材料候选配方，把原本需要多年的试验周期大幅缩短。
pairs.en: In scientific research, models help predict protein structures, screen drug molecules, and discover candidate formulas for new materials, dramatically shortening experimental cycles that once took years.

pairs.zh: 在交通领域，自动驾驶正沿着从辅助到全自动的路线逐步推进，车辆依靠摄像头、雷达与感知识别周边路况，把事故率进一步压低；
pairs.en: In transportation, autonomous driving is advancing step by step from assisted to fully automatic driving; vehicles rely on cameras, radar, and perception to recognize surrounding traffic, pushing accident rates even lower;

pairs.zh: 在司法领域，系统帮助法官检索类似判例、核对法条，让判决更一致；
pairs.en: in the judicial field, systems help judges retrieve similar precedents and verify statutes, making rulings more consistent;

pairs.zh: 在写作与设计领域，它能生成初稿、草图与配色方案，供专业人员挑选和修改。
pairs.en: and in writing and design, it generates drafts, sketches, and color schemes for professionals to select and refine.

pairs.zh: 教育也在被悄悄改变，系统可以根据每个学生的答题情况，判断他在哪一处卡住，再用不同讲法反复解释，相当于一位随时在线的辅导老师，让进度慢的孩子不至于掉队。
pairs.en: Education is also being quietly transformed: systems can judge where each student is stuck based on their answers and explain again in different ways, acting like an always-online tutor so that slower learners do not fall behind.

pairs.zh: 这些工具的共同特点，是把人从繁琐的第一步里解放出来，当然，越是智能的系统，越需要人在关键处把关，最终的判断与责任仍要由人来承担。
pairs.en: The common trait of these tools is that they free people from tedious first steps; of course, the smarter the system, the more it needs humans to supervise at critical points, and final judgment and responsibility still rest with people.

pairs.zh: 不过，技术强大也带来新责任。
pairs.en: Yet great power also brings new responsibilities.

pairs.zh: 模型可能照搬训练材料中的偏见，可能一本正经地编造并不存在的事实，也可能被用来制造以假乱真的音视频。
pairs.en: Models may copy biases from their training data, confidently fabricate facts that do not exist, or be used to produce highly realistic fake audio and video.

pairs.zh: 训练一个大型模型往往需要成千上万张显卡同时工作数周，消耗的电力不小。
pairs.en: Training a large model often requires tens of thousands of graphics cards working simultaneously for weeks, consuming a considerable amount of electricity.

pairs.zh: 因此，研究者正努力让回答更可靠、过程更透明、能耗更低，社会也在讨论怎样划定使用边界，保护个人隐私与作品权益。
pairs.en: Researchers are therefore working to make answers more reliable, processes more transparent, and energy use lower, while society debates how to draw boundaries for use and protect personal privacy and creators' rights.

pairs.zh: 有人担心它会取代大量岗位，但历史表明，新技术在淘汰旧职业的同时也会催生新职业，关键在于人是否愿意持续学习。
pairs.en: Some worry it will replace many jobs, but history shows that new technology eliminates old occupations while creating new ones; the key is whether people are willing to keep learning.

pairs.zh: 人工智能不是要取代人，而是把人从重复劳动中解放出来，让人把精力放在创造、判断与关怀上。
pairs.en: Artificial intelligence is not meant to replace people but to free them from repetitive labor, so that they can focus their energy on creation, judgment, and care.

pairs.zh: 未来，它会继续与各行各业深度融合，成为像水电一样平常的基础能力。
pairs.en: In the future, it will continue to merge deeply with every industry, becoming an ordinary foundational capability much like water and electricity.

pairs.zh: 理解它的原理，看清它的长处与短处，普通人才能更从容地迎接这场正在发生的变化。
pairs.en: Only by understanding its principles and seeing its strengths and weaknesses can ordinary people more calmly embrace this ongoing change.

pairs.zh: 云，在过去只是天空中的水汽，如今却成了一种可以随取随用的计算资源。
pairs.en: Clouds used to be nothing but water vapor in the sky, but today they have become a computing resource that can be drawn upon at will.

pairs.zh: 所谓云计算，简单说就是把计算、存储、网络等能力集中到遥远的数据中心，再像供水供电那样按需分配给用户。
pairs.en: Cloud computing, in simple terms, concentrates computing, storage, and networking capabilities in remote data centers and distributes them to users on demand, just like water and electricity.

pairs.zh: 你不必在办公室里堆昂贵的服务器，只要接入网络，就能租用几台、几百台甚至几千台机器的算力，用多少付多少，用完随时释放。
pairs.en: You do not need to pile expensive servers in your office; once connected to the network, you can rent the computing power of a few, hundreds, or even thousands of machines, paying only for what you use and releasing it whenever you are done.

pairs.zh: 这种模式让创业公司不必先投入巨资买设备，几个人的小团队也能调度足够的计算资源去跑复杂模型。
pairs.en: This model lets startups avoid investing heavily in equipment up front, allowing even small teams to marshal enough computing resources to run complex models.

pairs.zh: 其实这种想法早有源头：早年人们把程序存放在大型主机上，多个终端分时使用；
pairs.en: The idea actually has deep roots: in early days people stored programs on large mainframes that multiple terminals shared on a time basis;

pairs.zh: 后来又出现过网格计算与效用计算的设想，只是受限于网络速度与成本，一直没有普及，直到宽带普及与虚拟化技术成熟，云才真正落地。
pairs.en: later, ideas like grid computing and utility computing appeared, but they were limited by network speed and cost and never became widespread until broadband spread and virtualization matured, which is when the cloud truly landed.

pairs.zh: 大公司则把闲置的机房能力对外开放，形成规模效应，单位计算的成本逐年下降。
pairs.en: Large companies then opened up their idle data-center capacity to the public, creating economies of scale and driving the unit cost of computing down year after year.

pairs.zh: 从服务形式看，云又分好几层：有的直接出租裸机与硬盘，让使用者自己安装系统；
pairs.en: In terms of service forms, the cloud is divided into several layers: some rent out bare machines and hard drives, letting users install their own systems;

pairs.zh: 有的提供现成的开发平台，程序员不必操心底层运维；
pairs.en: some provide ready-made development platforms so that programmers do not have to worry about underlying operations;

pairs.zh: 有的干脆把整套软件放在网上，打开浏览器就能用。
pairs.en: and some simply put entire software suites online, usable right from a browser.

pairs.zh: 无论哪一层，目的都是让用户少操心设备，多专注业务。
pairs.en: Whichever layer it is, the goal is to let users worry less about equipment and focus more on their business.

pairs.zh: 从部署方式看，还有供一家独享的私有云、面向公众开放的公有云，以及两者结合的混合云，企业可以把敏感数据留在内部，把弹性需求交给外部。
pairs.en: In terms of deployment, there are private clouds for a single organization, public clouds open to everyone, and hybrid clouds that combine the two, letting enterprises keep sensitive data inside and hand elastic demand to the outside.

pairs.zh: 为了应对购物节那样瞬间暴涨的访问量，云平台还能自动扩容，流量过后又自动缩容，既不浪费也不拥挤。
pairs.en: To cope with surges in traffic like those on shopping festivals, cloud platforms can automatically scale up and then shrink back down once the traffic passes, neither wasting nor crowding.

pairs.zh: 云背后的数据中心本身也是一门学问，一排排服务器整齐排列，靠精密的制冷与供电系统维持恒温，人们还在不断想办法用水冷、风冷和绿色能源降低它的耗电。
pairs.en: The data centers behind the cloud are a discipline of their own: rows of servers stand neatly, kept at a constant temperature by precision cooling and power systems, and engineers keep seeking ways to cut electricity use with liquid cooling, air cooling, and green energy.

pairs.zh: 与云相伴而生的，是大数据。
pairs.en: Growing alongside the cloud is big data.

pairs.zh: 过去人们记录信息靠账本和表格，数据量小、结构整齐；
pairs.en: In the past, people recorded information with ledgers and tables, in small volumes with tidy structures;

pairs.zh: 如今一部智能手机一天产生的位置、照片、聊天记录，可能超过过去一个小县城一年的纸质档案。
pairs.en: today, a single smartphone generates more locations, photos, and chat records in one day than a small county used to produce in paper archives over a year.

pairs.zh: 电商平台要处理数亿用户的浏览与下单，短视频平台要在极短时间内为每个人挑选可能感兴趣的片段，气象台要汇聚遍布各地的观测站点数据来预测天气。
pairs.en: E-commerce platforms must handle browsing and orders from hundreds of millions of users, short-video platforms must pick out potentially interesting clips for every person in a fraction of a second, and weather bureaus must aggregate data from observation stations everywhere to forecast the weather.

pairs.zh: 这些数据不仅数量庞大，增长速度快，种类也混杂，既有整齐的数字，也有零散的文字、嘈杂的音视频，而真正有价值的信息往往藏在极小的比例之中。
pairs.en: Such data is not only enormous and fast-growing but also mixed in type, containing tidy numbers alongside scattered text and noisy audio and video, and the truly valuable information is often hidden in a very small proportion of it.

pairs.zh: 面对这样的数据，传统统计方法显得吃力，于是人们发展出分布式存储与并行计算的办法，把一个庞大任务拆成许多小块，分给成千上万台机器同时处理，再把结果汇总。
pairs.en: Faced with such data, traditional statistical methods struggle, so people developed distributed storage and parallel computing, splitting one huge task into many small pieces, handing them to thousands of machines to process simultaneously, and then merging the results.

pairs.zh: 对于需要即时反应的场景，人们还发展出流式计算，数据一产生就被分析，不必等到攒成厚厚的报表。
pairs.en: For scenarios that need immediate responses, people also developed stream computing, in which data is analyzed the moment it is produced rather than being saved up into thick reports.

pairs.zh: 大数据的价值在于发现过去看不见的规律。
pairs.en: The value of big data lies in discovering patterns that were previously invisible.

pairs.zh: 超市通过分析购物小票，发现某些商品在特定时段被一同买走，从而把相关商品摆在一起提升销量；
pairs.en: By analyzing shopping receipts, supermarkets find that certain products are bought together at specific times, so they place related items side by side to boost sales;

pairs.zh: 交通部门根据车流数据调整红绿灯配时，让早晚高峰少堵一段路；
pairs.en: traffic departments adjust traffic-light timing based on vehicle-flow data to shorten rush-hour congestion;

pairs.zh: 医院把多年的病历汇总，寻找某种疾病与生活习惯之间的关联；
pairs.en: hospitals aggregate years of medical records to look for links between diseases and lifestyles;

pairs.zh: 体育教练根据运动员的跑动与心率数据，安排更科学的训练量。
pairs.en: and sports coaches arrange more scientific training loads based on athletes' movement and heart-rate data.

pairs.zh: 这些发现不靠灵感，而靠在海量记录中反复比对。
pairs.en: These discoveries come not from inspiration but from repeated comparison across massive records.

pairs.zh: 大数据分析也进入了公共服务，气象部门融合卫星、雷达与地面观测，把台风路径预报得越来越准；
pairs.en: Big-data analysis has also entered public services: weather agencies fuse satellite, radar, and ground observations to forecast typhoon tracks ever more accurately;

pairs.zh: 交通调度根据历史规律提前预判拥堵热点；
pairs.en: traffic control predicts congestion hotspots in advance based on historical patterns;

pairs.zh: 公共卫生部门从就诊数据中及早发现传染病苗头，这些应用让城市运行得更聪明，也让居民少受排队与拥堵之苦。
pairs.en: and public-health departments spot early signs of infectious diseases from medical-visit data; these applications make cities run smarter and spare residents long queues and traffic jams.

pairs.zh: 当然，数据越有用，越要谨慎。
pairs.en: Of course, the more useful data becomes, the more carefully it must be handled.

pairs.zh: 数据里可能包含个人行踪、消费习惯、健康状况，一旦泄露或被滥用，会给普通人带来麻烦。
pairs.en: Data may contain personal whereabouts, consumption habits, and health conditions, and once leaked or misused, it can cause trouble for ordinary people.

pairs.zh: 因此，收集数据要事先告知，使用数据要限定范围，对外提供还要做脱敏处理，把能认出个人的信息抹去。
pairs.en: Therefore, collection must be announced in advance, use must be confined to a defined scope, and external sharing must include anonymization that removes details identifying individuals.

pairs.zh: 云与大数据合在一起，正在改变各行各业的工作方式。
pairs.en: Cloud and big data together are transforming how every industry works.

pairs.zh: 教育机构把课程放在云上，学生在偏远地区也能听到名师讲解；
pairs.en: Educational institutions put courses on the cloud so students in remote areas can hear lectures by renowned teachers;

pairs.zh: 制造企业把车间设备连上网络，用数据分析提前预判零件何时会磨损；
pairs.en: manufacturers connect workshop equipment to the network and use data analysis to predict when parts will wear out;

pairs.zh: 零售商家根据顾客偏好调整备货，减少积压；
pairs.en: retailers adjust stock according to customer preferences, reducing surplus;

pairs.zh: 政府把民生数据打通，让群众少跑窗口、多上网办。
pairs.en: and governments connect livelihood data so citizens can do more online and fewer trips to counters.

pairs.zh: 随着云承载的业务越来越关键，数据安全也成为头等大事。
pairs.en: As the cloud carries ever more critical business, data security has become a top priority.

pairs.zh: 服务商把数据分成多份存放在不同地点，即便某一处机房出了故障，服务也不会中断；
pairs.en: Service providers split data into multiple copies stored in different locations, so even if one data center fails, services do not stop;

pairs.zh: 传输过程中层层加密，外人截获了也读不懂。
pairs.en: transmission is encrypted layer by layer, so outsiders cannot read it even if they intercept it.

pairs.zh: 各国也陆续出台法律，要求企业明确告知数据用途，保障用户查阅与删除自己信息的权利。
pairs.en: Countries have also enacted laws requiring companies to clearly state how data will be used and guaranteeing users the right to view and delete their own information.

pairs.zh: 回到普通人的日常，云其实无处不在：手机相册自动备份，聊天记录跨设备同步，文档存在网上随时可取，在线看剧从不卡顿，背后都是云在支撑。
pairs.en: Back in everyday life, the cloud is everywhere: phone photo albums back up automatically, chat records sync across devices, documents live online for access anytime, and online shows never stutter, all supported by the cloud.

pairs.zh: 它把复杂的计算藏在幕后，只把简单好用的界面留给用户。
pairs.en: It hides complex computation behind the scenes and leaves only simple, friendly interfaces to users.

pairs.zh: 为了减少延迟，人们还把一部分计算放到靠近用户的边缘节点，让实时请求不必千里迢迢传回中心，这样智能摄像头、自动驾驶等对反应速度要求极高的应用才能跑得顺畅。
pairs.en: To reduce latency, people also move part of the computation to edge nodes close to users, so real-time requests do not have to travel thousands of miles to a central site; only then can applications demanding instant response, such as smart cameras and autonomous driving, run smoothly.

pairs.zh: 未来，随着连接设备越来越多，数据还会继续膨胀，云的规模也会继续扩大，普通人不必懂得其中复杂的技术细节，但应当明白自己每天都在享用这种便利。
pairs.en: In the future, as connected devices keep multiplying, data will keep expanding and the cloud will keep growing; ordinary people need not understand the complex technical details, but they should realize that they enjoy this convenience every day.

pairs.zh: 通信技术决定了人与世界之间信息流动的速度与宽度。
pairs.en: Communication technology determines the speed and breadth with which information flows between people and the world.

pairs.zh: 从二十世纪八十年代第一代只能通话的模拟移动电话，到后来能发短信、能浏览网页、能收看视频的几代技术，再到今天铺开的第五代移动通信，每一次换代都让连接更快、更稳、同时接入的设备更多。
pairs.en: From the first-generation analog mobile phones of the 1980s, which could only make calls, through later generations that could send texts, browse the web, and watch videos, to today's fifth-generation mobile networks rolling out everywhere, every upgrade has made connections faster, more stable, and able to admit more devices at once.

pairs.zh: 回望这一路，最初的移动电话笨重如砖，只能在少数地方通话；
pairs.en: Looking back along the way, the earliest mobile phones were as clunky as bricks and could only be used for calls in a few places;

pairs.zh: 后来数字制式普及，短信与图片开始在手机间流传；
pairs.en: later, digital standards spread, and text messages and pictures began to circulate between phones;

pairs.zh: 再往后，移动互联网爆发，人们随时随地打开地图、听音乐、看直播。
pairs.en: still later, the mobile Internet exploded, and people could open maps, listen to music, and watch live streams anytime, anywhere.

pairs.zh: 第五代移动通信正是站在这样的积累之上，它的突出特点是高速率、低时延和广连接。
pairs.en: Fifth-generation mobile communication builds on this accumulation; its defining traits are high speed, low latency, and massive connectivity.

pairs.zh: 它的下行速度比上一代快了十倍甚至几十倍，下载一部高清影片只需短短几十秒；
pairs.en: Its downlink speed is ten or even dozens of times faster than the previous generation, downloading a high-definition movie in just tens of seconds;

pairs.zh: 它的时延被压缩到几毫秒，几乎相当于设备之间即时响应；
pairs.en: its latency is squeezed down to a few milliseconds, almost like instant response between devices;

pairs.zh: 它还能在极小的内容纳海量设备同时在线，这为万物互联打下基础。
pairs.en: and it can accommodate a huge number of devices online simultaneously within a tiny area, laying the foundation for the Internet of Everything.

pairs.zh: 在第五代网络的支撑下，许多过去只能想象的场景逐渐变成现实。
pairs.en: With fifth-generation networks underneath, many scenarios that were once only imaginable are gradually becoming real.

pairs.zh: 远程手术中，医生借助高清视频和实时反馈操作机械臂，为千里之外的患者切除病灶；
pairs.en: In remote surgery, doctors operate robotic arms with the help of high-definition video and real-time feedback, removing lesions from patients thousands of miles away;

pairs.zh: 自动驾驶汽车把路况、位置传给云端，协同周边车辆避开拥堵与危险；
pairs.en: autonomous vehicles send road conditions and locations to the cloud and coordinate with nearby vehicles to avoid congestion and danger;

pairs.zh: 工厂里，传感器、机械臂、搬运小车彼此通信，整条产线像一个有知觉的整体；
pairs.en: in factories, sensors, robotic arms, and transport carts communicate with one another, making the whole production line act like a single sentient organism;

pairs.zh: 演唱会现场，数万名观众同时上传照片与短视频，网络也不至于崩溃。
pairs.en: at a concert, tens of thousands of spectators upload photos and short videos at the same time without crashing the network.

pairs.zh: 此外，第五代网络还被划分为不同用途的切片，好比在同一条公路上划出专用车道，给医疗、工业、应急等关键业务留出优先通道，保障它不被普通流量挤占。
pairs.en: In addition, fifth-generation networks can be divided into slices for different purposes, much like marking dedicated lanes on the same highway to reserve priority channels for critical services such as healthcare, industry, and emergency response, so they are never crowded out by ordinary traffic.

pairs.zh: 在城区，密集的小基站与更高频段的波让网速飞起来；
pairs.en: In urban areas, dense small cells and higher-frequency waves make network speeds soar;

pairs.zh: 在偏远地区，则借助中低频段覆盖更广的特点，把信号送到过去难以触及的角落。
pairs.en: in remote regions, the wider coverage of low- and mid-band frequencies carries signals to corners that were previously hard to reach.

pairs.zh: 智慧港口里，无人集卡沿着规划路线自动往返，吊机远程操控，整座码头少人化运转；
pairs.en: In smart ports, driverless trucks shuttle back and forth along planned routes while cranes are operated remotely, and the whole terminal runs with minimal staff;

pairs.zh: 应急现场，临时架设的基站让救援队伍在断网区域也能保持联络。
pairs.en: at emergency scenes, temporarily erected base stations keep rescue teams connected even in areas where the network is down.

pairs.zh: 第五代技术还有一项本领，就是把网络的控制功能从专用设备里抽离出来，用软件灵活调度，使运营商部署新业务更快、成本更低。
pairs.en: Fifth-generation technology has another skill: it lifts network control functions out of dedicated equipment and schedules them flexibly with software, letting operators roll out new services faster and at lower cost.

pairs.zh: 它在室内外都能提供稳定连接，让云游戏、云电脑成为可能，普通设备也能流畅运行过去需要高配电脑才能玩的大型游戏；
pairs.en: It delivers stable connections indoors and outdoors alike, making cloud gaming and cloud PCs possible so that ordinary devices can smoothly run large games that used to require high-end computers;

pairs.zh: 在农业中，它把田间的传感器、气象站与灌溉设备连成一片，旱情、虫害都能被及时发现。
pairs.en: in agriculture, it links field sensors, weather stations, and irrigation equipment into a single network, so droughts and pest outbreaks can be detected in time.

pairs.zh: 在文旅景区，智慧导览根据游客位置推送讲解；
pairs.en: At cultural and tourist sites, smart guides push explanations based on visitors' locations;

pairs.zh: 在校园与医院，高清视频远程会诊让基层患者也能请大城市的专家把脉。
pairs.en: on campuses and in hospitals, high-definition video consultations let patients at grassroots facilities seek expert opinions from big cities.

pairs.zh: 这些场景共同说明，新一代通信不只是让手机网速变快，更是在为整个社会的万物互联铺设底座。
pairs.en: Together, these scenarios show that the new generation of communication is not just making phone networks faster; it is laying the foundation for connecting everything across society.

pairs.zh: 然而人们没有停下脚步，第六代移动通信已经进入研究阶段。
pairs.en: Yet people have not stopped: sixth-generation mobile communication has already entered the research stage.

pairs.zh: 第六代并非简单地再快一点，而是要把通信与感知、计算、智能更紧密地融合在一起。
pairs.en: The sixth generation is not simply a bit faster; it aims to fuse communication with perception, computing, and intelligence more tightly.

pairs.zh: 研究者希望它的速率比第五代再提升数十倍，时延进一步降到接近于零，连接密度和定位精度也大幅提高。
pairs.en: Researchers hope its speed will be dozens of times higher than the fifth generation, its latency reduced to near zero, and its connection density and positioning accuracy greatly improved.

pairs.zh: 借助更高频段的波，第六代网络有望让通信信号同时承担雷达探测的功能，也就是说，网络不仅能传信息，还能感知周围环境中物体的位置与运动，为无人驾驶、智慧交通、室内导航提供全新手段。
pairs.en: Using higher-frequency waves, sixth-generation networks may let communication signals double as radar, meaning the network can not only transmit information but also sense the positions and movements of objects around it, offering brand-new tools for driverless driving, smart transportation, and indoor navigation.

pairs.zh: 太空与地面的协同也是重要方向，通过低空飞行器、卫星与地面基站配合，哪怕在海洋、沙漠、深山等没有铺设基站的地方，人们也能接入网络。
pairs.en: Collaboration between space and the ground is also an important direction: through low-altitude aircraft, satellites, and ground stations working together, people can access the network even in oceans, deserts, and deep mountains where no base stations have been built.

pairs.zh: 它还打算把人工智能嵌入网络本身，让系统自己判断哪里拥堵、哪里需要扩容，像有经验的调度员一样动态分配资源。
pairs.en: It also plans to embed artificial intelligence into the network itself, letting the system judge where congestion is and where capacity needs to expand, allocating resources dynamically like an experienced dispatcher.

pairs.zh: 面向第六代，研究者还希望实现通信与感知一体化，让通信基站同时化身环境感知的眼睛，识别远处物体的形状与速度，为自动驾驶提供车路协同之外的另一重保障。
pairs.en: Looking toward the sixth generation, researchers also hope to achieve integrated communication and sensing, turning base stations into environmental eyes that identify the shape and speed of distant objects, adding another layer of assurance for autonomous driving beyond vehicle-to-everything coordination.

pairs.zh: 它的定位精度有望达到厘米级，让室内导航、矿井搜救、资产追踪都变得更精准；
pairs.en: Its positioning accuracy is expected to reach the centimeter level, making indoor navigation, mine rescue, and asset tracking more precise;

pairs.zh: 网络的能效也要大幅提升，争取让每传输一位信息所耗的电力显著下降，避免通信越发展越费电。
pairs.en: and the energy efficiency of the network must also improve greatly, so that the electricity consumed per bit of information falls markedly and communication does not become more power-hungry as it develops.

pairs.zh: 当然，第六代距离大规模商用还有很长的路要走，需要解决频段资源、能耗、设备小型化、国际标准统一等一系列难题。
pairs.en: Of course, the sixth generation still has a long way to go before large-scale commercial use, needing to resolve a series of challenges such as spectrum resources, energy consumption, device miniaturization, and unified international standards.

pairs.zh: 更高频段的波绕射能力弱、覆盖距离短，基站要建得更密，造价与耗电都会上升。
pairs.en: Higher-frequency waves diffract weakly and cover short distances, so base stations must be built denser, raising both construction cost and electricity use.

pairs.zh: 科研团队普遍预计，第六代要再过十余年才能逐步走向商用，其间还要经过反复试验与国际协调。
pairs.en: Research teams generally expect that the sixth generation will take more than a decade to gradually reach the market, with repeated trials and international coordination along the way.

pairs.zh: 通信技术的代际更替往往以十年为尺度，每一次换代都需要重新规划频谱、更新终端、铺设基站，并让设备制造商、运营商、应用开发者协同推进，正因如此，第六代的研究必须今天就启动，才能在十余年后如期接过接力棒。
pairs.en: Generational change in communication technology typically unfolds on a ten-year scale; every upgrade requires re-planning spectrum, updating terminals, deploying base stations, and coordinating equipment makers, operators, and application developers, which is why research on the sixth generation must start today to take over the baton on schedule more than ten years from now.

pairs.zh: 未来相当长一段时间里，第五代网络仍会是主流，第六代则在特定行业率先试点。
pairs.en: For quite a long time to come, fifth-generation networks will remain the mainstream, while the sixth generation will be piloted first in specific industries.

pairs.zh: 但可以预见，当第六代成熟时，远程全息会议、身临其境的沉浸式娱乐、遍布城市的智能基础设施，都将成为日常。
pairs.en: But it is foreseeable that when the sixth generation matures, remote holographic meetings, immersive entertainment, and smart infrastructure spread across cities will all become part of daily life.

pairs.zh: 通信技术每前进一代，都会催生出一批今天难以预料的新行业与新职业。
pairs.en: Every generation of communication technology gives birth to new industries and new occupations that are hard to predict today.

pairs.zh: 理解这两代技术的联系与区别，有助于我们把握未来数字生活的走向，也让社会在拥抱便利的同时，提前思考频谱分配、数据安全与城乡数字鸿沟等需要共同面对的问题。
pairs.en: Understanding the connections and differences between these two generations helps us grasp the direction of future digital life, and lets society think ahead about shared challenges such as spectrum allocation, data security, and the digital divide between cities and rural areas while embracing convenience.

pairs.zh: 信任，是一切交易的基础。
pairs.en: Trust is the foundation of every transaction.

pairs.zh: 过去，人们依靠银行、公证机构、平台客服这样的中间方来确认一笔钱是否到账、一份合同是否有效。
pairs.en: In the past, people relied on intermediaries such as banks, notary offices, and platform customer service to confirm whether money had arrived or a contract was valid.

pairs.zh: 这些中间方固然可靠，却也要付出成本，而且环节一多，速度就慢下来。
pairs.en: These intermediaries are reliable, but they come at a cost, and the more links in the chain, the slower things become.

pairs.zh: 区块链提供了另一种思路：不把账本交给单一机构保管，而是让许多参与者各自保存一份完全相同的副本，任何改动都要经过多数节点认可并被永久记录，谁也无法偷偷涂改旧账。
pairs.en: Blockchain offers another approach: instead of entrusting the ledger to a single institution, many participants each keep an identical copy, any change must be approved by the majority of nodes and is recorded permanently, and no one can secretly alter the old records.

pairs.zh: 这套办法的技术核心，是密码学哈希与分布式共识。
pairs.en: The technological core of this approach is cryptographic hashing and distributed consensus.

pairs.zh: 所谓哈希，就是把任意一段信息压缩成一串固定长度的指纹，原文哪怕改动一个字，指纹也会面目全非；
pairs.en: A hash compresses any piece of information into a fixed-length fingerprint, and if even one character of the original changes, the fingerprint is completely transformed;

pairs.zh: 所谓共识，就是网络中互不相识的节点通过约定的规则，对账本当前的状态达成一致。
pairs.en: consensus means that nodes that do not know each other reach agreement on the current state of the ledger through agreed rules.

pairs.zh: 一笔交易发出后，会向全网广播，节点们把一段时间内的交易收集起来打包成一个块，再经过竞争或投票确认这个块合法，把它接到链条末尾。
pairs.en: When a transaction is issued, it is broadcast across the network; nodes collect the transactions of a period into a block, confirm its validity through competition or voting, and attach it to the end of the chain.

pairs.zh: 这种共同记账的方式，让信任不再依赖某个中心，而来自规则本身与众人的监督。
pairs.en: This way of keeping the ledger together makes trust depend not on any center but on the rules themselves and on the scrutiny of everyone.

pairs.zh: 按开放程度，区块链又分几类：面向公众开放、任何人都能参与的叫公有链；
pairs.en: By openness, blockchain is divided into several types: a public chain is open to all and anyone can participate;

pairs.zh: 由若干机构共同管理、加入需要授权的叫联盟链；
pairs.en: a consortium chain is jointly managed by several institutions and requires authorization to join;

pairs.zh: 仅供一家内部使用的叫私有链。
pairs.en: and a private chain is used internally by a single organization.

pairs.zh: 不同类型在效率、隐私与开放度之间各有取舍，金融、政务等场景多用联盟链，以兼顾可信与可控。
pairs.en: Different types trade off efficiency, privacy, and openness differently; finance and government scenarios mostly use consortium chains to balance credibility with control.

pairs.zh: 在确认一个块时，不同网络采用不同规则，有的靠大家比拼计算力来争得记账权，有的凭持有的份额与信誉投票，规则设计直接关系到能耗与安全。
pairs.en: When confirming a block, different networks use different rules: some compete by computing power for the right to keep the ledger, while others vote according to holdings and reputation, and the design of the rules directly affects energy consumption and security.

pairs.zh: 区块链上的记录按时间顺序连成一串，每一块都包含前一块的指纹信息，一旦某条记录被写入，改动它就必须同时改动后续所有块，在节点众多的网络里几乎不可能做到。
pairs.en: Records on the blockchain are linked in chronological order, and each block contains the fingerprint of the previous one; once a record is written, altering it requires altering all subsequent blocks at the same time, which is practically impossible in a network with many nodes.

pairs.zh: 这套特性使它特别适合需要存证与追溯的场合。
pairs.en: These properties make it especially suitable for scenarios that need evidence preservation and traceability.

pairs.zh: 比如一件手工艺品从原料产地、加工车间到专柜货架，每一个环节的信息都记在链上，消费者扫码就能看到它的来历，遇到假货也能顺藤摸瓜找到责任环节。
pairs.en: For example, for a piece of handicraft, every stage from raw-material origin, through the processing workshop, to the boutique shelf is recorded on the chain, so consumers can scan a code to see its history and, when encountering counterfeits, trace the responsible link.

pairs.zh: 再如版权登记，作者完成作品时就把时间戳与作品指纹写进链上，日后若发生纠纷，这份不可篡改的记录就是有力证据。
pairs.en: Likewise with copyright registration: when an author completes a work, the timestamp and the work's fingerprint are written onto the chain, and if a dispute arises later, this tamper-proof record is strong evidence.

pairs.zh: 粮食从田间到餐桌的每一次转手，药品从出厂到药房的每一次流通，司法过程中的关键证据，不动产的每一次过户，都能借助这种可追溯性，让公众吃得放心、用得安心、争议有据可查。
pairs.en: Every transfer of grain from field to table, every movement of medicine from factory to pharmacy, key evidence in judicial proceedings, and every property transfer can all draw on this traceability, letting the public eat with confidence, use goods with peace of mind, and settle disputes with verifiable records.

pairs.zh: 数字经济的繁荣，让区块链找到了更多用武之地。
pairs.en: The prosperity of the digital economy has given blockchain more room to shine.

pairs.zh: 数字货币是其中最受关注的方向之一，由央行发行的数字人民币把纸币的方便与电子支付的快捷结合起来，在没有网络的场合，两部手机轻轻一碰也能完成转账。
pairs.en: Digital currency is one of the most watched directions; the digital yuan issued by the central bank combines the convenience of paper money with the speed of electronic payment, and even without a network, two phones can complete a transfer with a simple tap.

pairs.zh: 智能合约则把合同条款写成自动执行的程序，条件一旦满足，款项自动划转，不必担心一方反悔。
pairs.en: Smart contracts turn contract terms into self-executing programs: once the conditions are met, the payment moves automatically, with no need to worry about one party backing out.

pairs.zh: 在供应链金融中，核心企业的信用可以沿着真实的贸易记录层层传递，让原本难以贷到款的中小供应商也能凭链上记录获得融资。
pairs.en: In supply-chain finance, the credit of core enterprises can pass layer by layer along real trade records, so small suppliers that once found it hard to obtain loans can secure financing based on their on-chain records.

pairs.zh: 慈善捐款也能借助链上记录做到每一笔去向可查，捐赠人清楚看到善款最终用在了哪里。
pairs.en: Charitable donations can also use on-chain records to make every destination traceable, so donors can clearly see where their money finally went.

pairs.zh: 跨境结算过去要经过多家代理银行，动辄一两天，链上系统则能把清算时间压缩到分钟级，费用也更低。
pairs.en: Cross-border settlement used to pass through multiple correspondent banks and take a day or two; on-chain systems can compress clearing time to minutes at lower cost.

pairs.zh: 数字藏品、电子发票、会员积分兑换，也纷纷借助链上记录变得更加可信、更难伪造。
pairs.en: Digital collectibles, electronic invoices, and membership-point redemption are also becoming more credible and harder to forge with on-chain records.

pairs.zh: 区块链还在版权与文创领域展现价值，数字作品一旦上链，每一次转售都能被记录，原作者可以按约定持续获得分成，激发更多人潜心创作；
pairs.en: Blockchain is also showing value in copyright and cultural creativity: once a digital work is on the chain, every resale is recorded, original creators can keep receiving a share as agreed, motivating more people to devote themselves to creation;

pairs.zh: 在公益与审计中，每一笔资金流向透明可查，减少了暗箱操作的空间。
pairs.en: in charity and auditing, every fund flow is transparent and traceable, reducing room for behind-the-scenes manipulation.

pairs.zh: 随着数字人民币试点范围扩大，更多人将亲身体验到链上结算的便捷；
pairs.en: As the digital yuan pilot expands, more people will personally experience the convenience of on-chain settlement;

pairs.zh: 行业也在探索如何降低能耗、提升每秒处理能力，让这项技术更适合大规模落地。
pairs.en: the industry is also exploring how to reduce energy consumption and raise per-second processing capacity so that the technology is better suited for large-scale deployment.

pairs.zh: 不过，区块链并非万能。
pairs.en: However, blockchain is not a panacea.

pairs.zh: 它追求不可篡改，一旦写错也难以撤回，这既是优点也是风险；
pairs.en: It pursues immutability, so once something is written in error, it is hard to withdraw; this is both an advantage and a risk;

pairs.zh: 它为了让众多节点达成一致，需要消耗不少计算与电力；
pairs.en: to make many nodes agree, it consumes a good deal of computation and electricity;

pairs.zh: 链上每秒能处理的笔数还不多，面对高并发场景仍需改进；
pairs.en: the number of transactions it can process per second is still limited, and it still needs improvement for high-concurrency scenarios;

pairs.zh: 链上资产价格波动剧烈，夹杂着投机与骗局，普通投资者很容易被高收益的许诺误导。
pairs.en: on-chain asset prices fluctuate wildly and are mixed with speculation and scams, and ordinary investors can easily be misled by promises of high returns.

pairs.zh: 还需冷静看到的是，上链之前的信息是否真实，仍要靠线下核验，链条再可信，也无法自动保证源头没有造假。
pairs.en: It is also important to see soberly that whether the information recorded before going on-chain is truthful still depends on offline verification; however trustworthy the chain is, it cannot automatically guarantee that the source has not been falsified.

pairs.zh: 因此，理性的做法是把它当作一项工具，用在确实需要多方信任、需要可追溯的场景里，而不是盲目追捧。
pairs.en: Therefore, the rational approach is to treat it as a tool and use it in scenarios that genuinely need multi-party trust and traceability, rather than blindly chasing it.

pairs.zh: 各国监管也在加快明确规则，防范洗钱与诈骗，保护普通用户。
pairs.en: Regulators around the world are also speeding up the clarification of rules to prevent money laundering and fraud and protect ordinary users.

pairs.zh: 与其把它神化为无所不能，不如把它看作一种加固信任的手段，与制度、法律配合使用。
pairs.en: Rather than mythologizing it as all-powerful, we should see it as a means of reinforcing trust, used alongside institutions and laws.

pairs.zh: 随着监管逐渐清晰、技术不断成熟，区块链会与实体经济更深地结合，成为数字经济中加固信任的一块基石。
pairs.en: As regulation becomes clearer and the technology matures, blockchain will integrate more deeply with the real economy and become a cornerstone of reinforced trust in the digital economy.

pairs.zh: 普通人不必深究密码学细节，只需明白，这项技术正在悄然改变我们记账、签约与协作的方式。
pairs.en: Ordinary people need not dig into the details of cryptography; they only need to understand that this technology is quietly changing the way we keep accounts, sign contracts, and collaborate.

pairs.zh: 当越来越多的合同、票据、凭证都能在链上找到可信的记录，社会协作的摩擦会进一步降低，数字经济也会在更加透明、更加可信的基础上持续生长，让每一次交易、每一份合约都更让人放心，也让市场运转得更加顺畅。
pairs.en: As more and more contracts, bills, and certificates find credible records on the chain, friction in social collaboration will drop further, and the digital economy will keep growing on a more transparent and trustworthy foundation, making every transaction and every contract more reassuring and markets run more smoothly.

pairs.zh: 计算机的基本单位是比特，它在某一时刻只能是零或一，就像一枚正面或朝下的硬币。
pairs.en: The basic unit of a computer is the bit, which at any moment can only be zero or one, like a coin showing heads or tails.

pairs.zh: 量子计算借用微观世界的奇妙规则，让量子比特能够同时处于零与一的叠加状态，再借助纠缠把许多比特关联起来。
pairs.en: Quantum computing borrows the wondrous rules of the microscopic world, allowing qubits to exist simultaneously in a superposition of zero and one, and then links many qubits together through entanglement.

pairs.zh: 所谓纠缠，是指两个粒子无论相隔多远，一个的状态变化会立刻在另一个身上体现出来，仿佛它们之间有某种隐秘的联系。
pairs.en: Entanglement means that no matter how far apart two particles are, a change in the state of one is instantly reflected in the other, as if they shared some hidden connection.

pairs.zh: 这样一来，当系统规模扩大时，它能同时探索的可能性空间呈指数级增长。
pairs.en: As a result, when the system grows larger, the space of possibilities it can explore at once grows exponentially.

pairs.zh: 这意味着，某些传统计算机需要成千上万年才能算完的问题，量子计算机也许在很短时间内就能给出答案。
pairs.en: This means that some problems that would take a traditional computer thousands or even millions of years to solve might be answered by a quantum computer in a very short time.

pairs.zh: 当然，这并非要取代我们手里的电脑，而是专攻那些特别适合并行搜索与复杂模拟的难题，日常的文档处理、网页浏览仍由经典计算机胜任。
pairs.en: Of course, this is not about replacing the computers in our hands; rather, it targets problems especially suited to parallel search and complex simulation, while everyday document processing and web browsing remain the job of classical computers.

pairs.zh: 目前实现量子比特有好几条路线，有的用超导电路，有的用俘获的离子，有的用光子，各有长短，科学家仍在比较哪条路线更容易走通。
pairs.en: There are currently several routes to building qubits: some use superconducting circuits, some use trapped ions, and some use photons, each with its own strengths and weaknesses, and scientists are still comparing which route is easier to make practical.

pairs.zh: 要理解量子计算的威力，不妨做个比喻：经典计算机像一位逐页翻阅名册的查号员，一页一页看过去；
pairs.en: To grasp the power of quantum computing, consider an analogy: a classical computer is like a directory assistant flipping through a roster page by page;

pairs.zh: 量子计算机则像同时翻开所有页面，在叠加状态里一次扫过无数种组合。
pairs.en: a quantum computer is like opening every page at once, sweeping across countless combinations in a single superposition.

pairs.zh: 当组合数量达到天文数字时，这种并行带来的优势是颠覆性的。
pairs.en: When the number of combinations reaches astronomical figures, this parallelism delivers an advantage that is truly disruptive.

pairs.zh: 不过量子比特极不稳定，保持相干的时间往往只有短短几微秒，科学家必须在它失稳之前尽快完成计算。
pairs.en: However, qubits are extremely unstable, and the coherence time often lasts only a few microseconds, so scientists must complete the calculation before the state collapses.

pairs.zh: 药物研发是最被看好的方向之一。
pairs.en: Drug development is one of the most promising directions.

pairs.zh: 分子间的相互作用本质上遵循量子规律，用经典计算机模拟起来异常吃力，而量子计算机天生就擅长处理这类问题。
pairs.en: The interactions between molecules essentially follow quantum laws, and simulating them with classical computers is extraordinarily difficult, while quantum computers are naturally good at such problems.

pairs.zh: 研究者希望借助它更快地筛选出候选药物分子，理解蛋白质如何折叠，从而缩短新药从实验室到病床的漫长周期。
pairs.en: Researchers hope to use them to screen candidate drug molecules faster and to understand how proteins fold, thereby shortening the long journey of new medicines from the laboratory to the bedside.

pairs.zh: 材料科学同样受益，人们可以在计算机里设计出更强的合金、更高效的电池材料、更轻薄的光伏涂层，而不必一遍遍做昂贵的实物试验。
pairs.en: Materials science benefits as well: people can design stronger alloys, more efficient battery materials, and thinner photovoltaic coatings on a computer, without repeatedly running expensive physical experiments.

pairs.zh: 在运筹与优化领域，量子计算有望为物流配送、航班调度、金融组合寻找更优方案，省下大量成本。
pairs.en: In operations research and optimization, quantum computing may find better solutions for logistics delivery, flight scheduling, and financial portfolios, saving substantial costs.

pairs.zh: 密码学领域则是另一番景象：现有的许多加密方法之所以安全，是因为大数分解太难算，量子计算机一旦足够强大，就可能在短时间内完成这种分解，这促使各国提前布局新一代抗量子密码，以免今天加密的信息在未来被轻易破解。
pairs.en: Cryptography is a different story: many current encryption methods are secure only because factoring large numbers is too hard, and once quantum computers become powerful enough, they might complete such factoring in a short time, which is prompting countries to prepare next-generation quantum-resistant cryptography so that information encrypted today is not easily broken in the future.

pairs.zh: 要实现这些愿景，困难也不小。
pairs.en: Realizing these visions is no small challenge.

pairs.zh: 量子比特极其脆弱，周围微小的震动、温度起伏、电磁干扰都可能让它丢失状态，这种现象叫做退相干。
pairs.en: Qubits are extremely fragile: tiny vibrations, temperature fluctuations, and electromagnetic interference around them can all destroy their state, a phenomenon called decoherence.

pairs.zh: 为此，科学家必须把芯片冷却到接近绝对零度，也就是比宇宙深空还要冷的程度，并用极精密的装置加以隔离，同时还要不断纠错。
pairs.en: For this reason, scientists must cool the chips to near absolute zero, colder than the depths of space, isolate them with extremely precise apparatus, and constantly correct errors.

pairs.zh: 一个真正可靠的量子计算机，往往需要用成百上千个脆弱的物理比特去拼出一个稳定的逻辑比特。
pairs.en: A truly reliable quantum computer often needs hundreds or thousands of fragile physical qubits to assemble one stable logical qubit.

pairs.zh: 目前的原型机比特数还不算多，出错率偏高，距离真正解决有实用价值的难题仍有距离，行业普遍把这一阶段称作含噪声的早期探索期。
pairs.en: Today's prototypes still have limited qubit counts and high error rates, and remain far from solving practically valuable problems; the industry commonly calls this stage the noisy early exploration period.

pairs.zh: 尽管如此，进展令人振奋：实验室里已经造出数百个量子比特的处理器，在某些精心设计的问题上，展示出超越最强经典机器的苗头，让学界看到了曙光。
pairs.en: Even so, progress is exciting: laboratories have already built processors with hundreds of qubits that, on certain carefully designed problems, show signs of surpassing the strongest classical machines, giving the research community a glimpse of dawn.

pairs.zh: 当然，这类超越往往只针对专门构造的难题，并不意味着量子计算机已经在通用计算上全面领先，真正的实用化仍需要更长时间的积累与更多纠错技术的突破。
pairs.en: Of course, such supremacy usually targets specially constructed problems only, and does not mean quantum computers are comprehensively ahead in general computing; true practical use still needs longer accumulation and more breakthroughs in error correction.

pairs.zh: 量子计算只是前沿科技浪潮中的一朵浪花。
pairs.en: Quantum computing is just one wave in the tide of frontier technology.

pairs.zh: 与之相伴的，还有可柔性折叠的显示屏、能在自然环境中降解的新型材料、帮助残疾人恢复感知的脑机接口、可控核聚变的持续攻关、把二氧化碳转化为燃料的探索。
pairs.en: Alongside it are flexible foldable displays, new materials that degrade naturally in the environment, brain-computer interfaces that help the disabled regain sensation, sustained efforts on controlled nuclear fusion, and exploration of converting carbon dioxide into fuel.

pairs.zh: 这些方向看似分散，背后却有共同的逻辑，即人类不断向微观尺度、向极限条件、向生命本身追问。
pairs.en: These directions seem scattered, yet they share a common logic: humanity keeps questioning the microscopic scale, extreme conditions, and life itself.

pairs.zh: 前沿探索往往耗时长久、失败率高，却一旦突破便会重塑整个产业，也会引出关于资源分配、伦理边界与安全竞争的新讨论。
pairs.en: Frontier exploration often takes a long time and fails often, yet once a breakthrough comes, it reshapes entire industries and opens new debates about resource allocation, ethical boundaries, and security competition.

pairs.zh: 脑机接口尝试在大脑与机器之间建立直接通道，让失去肢体的人用意念操控机械臂，也让听力障碍者重新感知声音；
pairs.en: Brain-computer interfaces try to build a direct channel between the brain and machines, letting people who have lost limbs control robotic arms with their thoughts and helping the hearing impaired perceive sound again;

pairs.zh: 合成生物学用设计基因的思路制造新的微生物，用于生产燃料与药物；
pairs.en: synthetic biology uses the idea of designing genes to create new microorganisms for producing fuels and medicines;

pairs.zh: 这些新方向在带来希望的同时，也涉及隐私与安全的边界，需要公众讨论与国际规则，让技术朝着造福多数人的方向发展。
pairs.en: while bringing hope, these new directions also touch the boundaries of privacy and security, requiring public discussion and international rules so that technology develops toward benefiting the majority.

pairs.zh: 对普通读者来说，不必害怕这些术语，可以把量子计算理解为一种正在成长的新型计算方式，它与经典计算互补，而不是互相替代，就像显微镜不会取代望远镜，而是各自照亮不同的尺度。
pairs.en: For ordinary readers, there is no need to fear these terms; quantum computing can be understood as a new kind of computing that is still growing, complementing rather than replacing classical computing, just as a microscope does not replace a telescope but illuminates a different scale.

pairs.zh: 对普通人而言，不必急于计算它何时到来，但应当保持关注与好奇。
pairs.en: For ordinary people, there is no need to rush to calculate when it will arrive, but it is worth staying attentive and curious.

pairs.zh: 因为今天实验室里的一次微小跃迁，很可能在若干年后变成我们日常使用的工具，就像当年最初几间实验室里的晶体管，最终点亮了整个数字时代。
pairs.en: Because a tiny leap in today's laboratory may well become a tool we use daily years later, just as the first transistors in a few early laboratories ultimately lit up the entire digital age.

pairs.zh: 量子计算能否如期成熟，仍是开放的问题，但它所代表的探索精神，以及它与材料、医药、能源等领域的交汇，注定会成为未来几十年最激动人心的篇章之一，也会吸引一代又一代年轻人投身其中，把今天的好奇变成明天的创造，推动人类认识世界的边界不断向前延伸。
pairs.en: Whether quantum computing matures on schedule remains an open question, but the spirit of exploration it represents, and its intersections with materials, medicine, and energy, are destined to be among the most exciting chapters of the coming decades, attracting generation after generation of young people to turn today's curiosity into tomorrow's creations and push the boundaries of human understanding ever forward.

pairs.zh: 半导体芯片是现代电子设备的大脑，小到手机手表，大到汽车电网，几乎每一样产品都离不开它。
pairs.en: Semiconductor chips are the brains of modern electronic devices; from phones and watches to cars and power grids, almost every product depends on them.

pairs.zh: 一片指甲盖大小的芯片上，可以排列几十亿个微小的晶体管，它们像成千上万道闸门一样，控制着电流的开合，从而完成计算、存储和信号处理等任务。
pairs.en: On a chip the size of a fingernail, billions of tiny transistors can be arranged, acting like countless gates that switch electric current on and off to perform computation, storage, and signal processing.

pairs.zh: 芯片的制造过程极其复杂，需要经过设计、制造、封装、测试等许多环节，每一个环节都需要昂贵的设备、精密的工艺和长年积累的经验。
pairs.en: Manufacturing a chip is extremely complex, passing through design, fabrication, packaging, and testing, and every stage requires expensive equipment, precision processes, and experience accumulated over many years.

pairs.zh: 人们常把芯片比作工业皇冠上的明珠，正是因为它凝聚了人类在材料、机械、光学、化学等多个领域的最高成就。
pairs.en: People often call the chip the jewel on the crown of industry, precisely because it embodies humanity's highest achievements across materials, machinery, optics, and chemistry.

pairs.zh: 生产一颗芯片需要上千道工序，任何一步出现微小偏差，整批产品都可能报废，因此车间里必须保持极高的洁净度，灰尘都要以百万分之一毫米来计算。
pairs.en: Producing a single chip involves thousands of process steps; a tiny deviation in any one step can scrap an entire batch, so the workshop must maintain extreme cleanliness, with dust measured in parts per million of a millimeter.

pairs.zh: 过去很长一段时间里，高端芯片的设计工具、制造设备和关键材料大多掌握在少数几家外国公司手中。
pairs.en: For a long time, the design tools, manufacturing equipment, and key materials for high-end chips were mostly held by a handful of foreign companies.

pairs.zh: 一台用于光刻的机器，价格动辄上亿美元，全球能够生产的厂家也寥寥无几。
pairs.en: A lithography machine can cost hundreds of millions of dollars, and only a very few manufacturers in the world can produce one.

pairs.zh: 这种局面让人们意识到，核心技术如果长期依赖别人，一旦外部环境发生变化，整条产业链就可能面临断供的风险。
pairs.en: This situation made people realize that if core technology depends on others for long, a change in the external environment could put the entire industrial chain at risk of supply disruption.

pairs.zh: 正是基于这样的认识，近年来我国把半导体国产化提升到了十分重要的位置，投入大量资源培养人才、建设生产线、扶持本土企业，许多高校也纷纷增设微电子、集成电路等专业，为行业输送新鲜血液。
pairs.en: Driven by this understanding, China has in recent years elevated the localization of semiconductors to a position of great importance, investing substantial resources in cultivating talent, building production lines, and supporting local enterprises, while many universities have added programs in microelectronics and integrated circuits to supply fresh blood to the industry.

pairs.zh: 各地还设立了专门的产业基金，鼓励社会资本进入这个周期长、风险高的领域。
pairs.en: Various regions have also set up dedicated industrial funds to encourage private capital into this field, which is long in cycle and high in risk.

pairs.zh: 如今，国内已经涌现出一批从事芯片设计的公司，它们在手机处理器、人工智能计算、智能家居、汽车电子等领域拿出了自己的产品。
pairs.en: Today, a number of chip-design companies have emerged domestically, offering their own products in mobile processors, AI computing, smart home, and automotive electronics.

pairs.zh: 与此同时，制造、封装、测试等环节也在稳步推进，国产设备和材料的比例逐年提高。
pairs.en: Meanwhile, fabrication, packaging, and testing are advancing steadily, and the share of domestic equipment and materials is rising year by year.

pairs.zh: 一些以前完全依靠进口的光刻胶、特种气体、抛光液，现在已经能在国内找到合格的替代品，供应链的韧性明显增强。
pairs.en: Some photoresists, specialty gases, and polishing slurries that once had to be imported entirely now have qualified domestic alternatives, significantly strengthening the resilience of the supply chain.

pairs.zh: 当然，我们也要清醒地看到，从设计到制造之间还有一道很长的坡，越往高端走，工艺难度越大，需要解决的问题越多，绝非一朝一夕可以完成。
pairs.en: Of course, we must also see clearly that there is a long slope between design and fabrication: the higher the end, the greater the process difficulty and the more problems to solve, and it is by no means achievable overnight.

pairs.zh: 光刻机的镜头、超纯的硅片、精密的量测仪器，每一项都需要持续投入和反复试错。
pairs.en: The lenses of lithography machines, ultra-pure silicon wafers, and precision measurement instruments each require sustained investment and repeated trial and error.

pairs.zh: 国产化并不是要闭门造车，更不是拒绝国际合作。
pairs.en: Localization is not about working behind closed doors, nor is it about rejecting international cooperation.

pairs.zh: 真正健康的做法，是在开放交流的同时，把关键环节逐步掌握在自己手里，形成既能参与全球分工，又能在特殊情况下独立运转的能力。
pairs.en: A genuinely healthy approach is to keep key links gradually in our own hands while remaining open to exchange, building the ability to both participate in the global division of labor and operate independently under exceptional circumstances.

pairs.zh: 对普通人来说，这意味着将来买到的电子产品会更加实惠，工作和生活中的数据处理会更加顺畅，国家的信息基础设施也会更加安全可靠。
pairs.en: For ordinary people, this means that future electronics will be more affordable, data processing in work and life will run more smoothly, and the country's information infrastructure will become safer and more reliable.

pairs.zh: 无论是移动支付、高铁调度，还是天气预报、卫星导航，背后都离不开稳定可靠的芯片供应。
pairs.en: Whether it is mobile payments, high-speed rail scheduling, weather forecasting, or satellite navigation, all depend on a stable and reliable supply of chips.

pairs.zh: 当国产芯片能够满足大部分日常需求时，消费者对国外产品的过度依赖也会随之减轻。
pairs.en: When domestic chips can meet most daily needs, consumers' excessive dependence on foreign products will correspondingly ease.

pairs.zh: 发展芯片产业需要耐心。
pairs.en: Developing the chip industry requires patience.

pairs.zh: 一颗芯片从立项到量产，往往要走过五到十年的时间，期间要经历无数次失败和调整。
pairs.en: From project initiation to mass production, a chip often takes five to ten years, during which it endures countless failures and adjustments.

pairs.zh: 这既需要企业有长远的眼光，也需要使用者愿意给国产产品一个试用的机会。
pairs.en: This requires both long-term vision from enterprises and a willingness from users to give domestic products a try.

pairs.zh: 当越来越多的人在自己的电脑、手机、汽车里用上国产芯片，整个产业就能在真实的市场反馈中不断改进，最终形成良性循环。
pairs.en: As more and more people use domestic chips in their computers, phones, and cars, the whole industry can keep improving through real market feedback and eventually form a virtuous cycle.

pairs.zh: 芯片虽小，承载的却是一个国家制造业转型升级的雄心和底气，也是几代科技工作者默默耕耘、久久为功的真实写照。
pairs.en: Small as chips are, they carry a country's ambition and confidence in manufacturing upgrading, and they are a true portrait of generations of scientists and engineers working quietly and persistently.

pairs.zh: 从追赶到并跑，再到未来的部分领跑，这条路虽然漫长，但每一步都走得坚实而有意义。
pairs.en: From chasing to running side by side, and in the future partly leading, the road is long, but every step is solid and meaningful.

pairs.zh: 其实芯片并不是一种东西，而是一个庞大的家族。
pairs.en: In fact, chips are not a single thing but a vast family.

pairs.zh: 负责运算的处理器、存储数据的内存和闪存、感应光线和声音的传感芯片、管理电量的电源芯片，各司其职，共同组成了电子产品的内部世界。
pairs.en: Processors for computation, memory and flash for storage, sensing chips for light and sound, and power-management chips for electricity each do their own job, together forming the internal world of electronic products.

pairs.zh: 过去我们谈国产化，往往把目光集中在最亮眼的手机处理器上，实际上，汽车里的控制芯片、家电里的电源芯片、工厂里的传感芯片，同样关系到国计民生。
pairs.en: In the past, discussions of localization often focused on the most eye-catching mobile processors; in reality, the control chips in cars, the power chips in appliances, and the sensing chips in factories equally concern the national economy and people's livelihoods.

pairs.zh: 这些芯片虽然性能不一定顶尖，却用量巨大、应用面广，正是国产企业可以稳步突破的方向。
pairs.en: These chips may not have the top performance, but they are produced in huge volumes and used widely, making them exactly the direction where domestic enterprises can make steady breakthroughs.

pairs.zh: 设计芯片离不开一套专门的软件工具，它们负责把工程师的想法变成可以制造的电路图，长期以来这套工具也依赖进口。
pairs.en: Designing chips depends on a set of specialized software tools that turn engineers' ideas into manufacturable circuit diagrams, and for a long time these tools also relied on imports.

pairs.zh: 可喜的是，国内几家软件公司已经推出了自己的设计平台，并在越来越多的项目中得到验证。
pairs.en: Encouragingly, several domestic software companies have launched their own design platforms and are gaining validation in more and more projects.

pairs.zh: 可以预见，随着产业链上下游协同发力，国产化的版图会一年比一年完整。
pairs.en: It is foreseeable that as the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain work together, the map of localization will become more complete year by year.

pairs.zh: 从消费端看，国产芯片带来的变化已经能被普通人体会到。
pairs.en: From the consumer side, the changes brought by domestic chips are already tangible to ordinary people.

pairs.zh: 过去一部旗舰手机的核心部件几乎全靠进口，价格居高不下；
pairs.en: In the past, the core components of a flagship phone were almost entirely imported, keeping prices high;

pairs.zh: 如今不少国产机型用上了自研处理器，运行速度流畅，价格却更加亲民，还在拍照、续航、信号等方面做了贴心的优化。
pairs.en: today, many domestic phone models use self-developed processors, run smoothly, and are priced more affordably, with thoughtful optimizations in photography, battery life, and signal.

pairs.zh: 汽车领域的变化更加明显，新能源汽车普遍采用国产芯片来管理电池、控制电机、辅助驾驶，整车的智能化水平不断提高。
pairs.en: The change in the automotive field is even more evident: new energy vehicles widely adopt domestic chips to manage batteries, control motors, and assist driving, steadily raising the level of vehicle intelligence.

pairs.zh: 这些看似细微的进步，背后都是无数研发人员日夜攻关的结果。
pairs.en: These seemingly minor advances are all the fruit of countless R&D personnel working day and night.

pairs.zh: 芯片国产化是一场没有终点的马拉松，唯有保持战略定力，一步一个脚印，才能在这场全球竞赛中站稳脚跟，为国家的高质量发展提供坚实支撑。
pairs.en: The localization of chips is a marathon without a finish line; only by maintaining strategic resolve and taking one solid step at a time can we stand firm in this global race and provide solid support for the country's high-quality development.

pairs.zh: 自动驾驶是近年来交通领域最受关注的话题之一。
pairs.en: Autonomous driving is one of the most discussed topics in transportation in recent years.

pairs.zh: 它依靠车上的摄像头、雷达和传感器，实时感知周围的车辆、行人、红绿灯和道路标志，再由车载电脑做出判断，决定是加速、减速还是转弯。
pairs.en: It relies on the cameras, radar, and sensors on the vehicle to perceive surrounding cars, pedestrians, traffic lights, and road signs in real time, and then the onboard computer makes judgments on whether to accelerate, brake, or turn.

pairs.zh: 按照自动化程度的不同，人们通常把它分成若干等级，从最初的辅助刹车、车道保持，到可以在特定路段自动行驶，再到理想状态下完全不需要人接管，每一步都意味着更高的技术难度和更大的安全责任。
pairs.en: Depending on the degree of automation, people usually divide it into several levels, from initial assisted braking and lane keeping, through automatic driving on specific sections, to ideally requiring no human intervention at all; each step means higher technical difficulty and greater safety responsibility.

pairs.zh: 要让机器像老司机一样判断复杂路况，需要在各种天气和时段下积累海量的行驶数据，再反复训练算法。
pairs.en: To make machines judge complex traffic like experienced drivers, enormous amounts of driving data must be accumulated across various weather conditions and times of day, and algorithms must be trained repeatedly.

pairs.zh: 一个成熟的系统，往往要经过几百万公里的实际路测，才能应对突发的降雨、大雾、逆光等状况。
pairs.en: A mature system often needs millions of kilometers of real road testing before it can cope with sudden rain, fog, and glare.

pairs.zh: 要实现真正的自动驾驶，光靠车上的设备还不够，还需要整个交通系统的配合。
pairs.en: To achieve true autonomous driving, equipment on the vehicle alone is not enough; the entire transportation system must cooperate.

pairs.zh: 这就是智能交通的概念。
pairs.en: This is the concept of intelligent transportation.

pairs.zh: 路两旁的摄像头可以把路况传回指挥中心，红绿灯可以根据车流量自动调整时长，公交车的到站信息可以实时推送到乘客的手机上。
pairs.en: Cameras along the roads can send traffic conditions back to command centers, traffic lights can automatically adjust their timing according to vehicle flow, and bus arrival information can be pushed to passengers' phones in real time.

pairs.zh: 当车辆、道路和管理平台连成一张网络，出行就会变得更加高效，拥堵和事故也有望大幅减少。
pairs.en: When vehicles, roads, and management platforms are connected into one network, travel becomes more efficient, and congestion and accidents are expected to drop significantly.

pairs.zh: 交警坐在指挥大厅里，就能通过大屏幕看到整条主干道的车流，一旦发生事故，系统会自动报警并引导后续车辆绕行。
pairs.en: Sitting in the command hall, traffic police can see the flow on an entire main road through a large screen; once an accident occurs, the system automatically alerts and guides following vehicles to detour.

pairs.zh: 停车场也能实现自动找位、自动计费，车主下车后，车子自己会停到空车位上，回来时一键召唤即可。
pairs.en: Parking lots can also achieve automatic space finding and billing: after the owner gets out, the car parks itself in an empty space, and a single tap on return summons it back.

pairs.zh: 在现实生活中，自动驾驶已经在一些有限场景里落地。
pairs.en: In real life, autonomous driving has already landed in some limited scenarios.

pairs.zh: 例如在港口和矿区，无人卡车可以按照预定路线往返运输货物，那里道路相对封闭、车速不快，适合技术先试先行；
pairs.en: For example, in ports and mining areas, driverless trucks can shuttle goods back and forth along preset routes, where roads are relatively enclosed and speeds are low, making them suitable for trying the technology first;

pairs.zh: 在一些工业园区和大学城，小型摆渡车可以接送乘客，沿线居民已经习惯了招手即停；
pairs.en: in some industrial parks and university towns, small shuttle buses can carry passengers, and residents along the routes have grown used to hailing them at a wave;

pairs.zh: 出租公司也开始在特定区域试运营无人驾驶车辆，乘客通过手机下单，上车后发现方向盘后并没有司机。
pairs.en: ride-hailing companies have also begun trial operations of driverless vehicles in specific areas, where passengers order through their phones and find no driver behind the wheel when they get in.

pairs.zh: 这些尝试虽然范围有限，却积累了宝贵的数据和经验，让技术人员不断修正算法，让规则制定者逐步完善法规。
pairs.en: Although limited in scope, these attempts accumulate valuable data and experience, letting engineers keep refining algorithms and regulators keep improving rules.

pairs.zh: 一些城市还划出了专门的测试道路，允许企业在真实环境中收集反馈。
pairs.en: Some cities have also designated special test roads, allowing companies to collect feedback in real environments.

pairs.zh: 推广自动驾驶也面临不少挑战。
pairs.en: Promoting autonomous driving also faces many challenges.

pairs.zh: 首先是安全，机器再聪明，也可能遇到突发天气、临时施工、行人突然横穿等复杂情况，如何在这些边缘场景中做出稳妥反应，是长期的课题。
pairs.en: The first is safety: no matter how smart the machine, it may encounter sudden weather, temporary construction, or pedestrians darting across the road, and how to respond reliably in these edge cases is a long-term topic.

pairs.zh: 其次是法律和伦理，一旦发生事故，责任应该由谁来承担，车主、软件提供方还是车辆制造商，都需要清晰的界定。
pairs.en: The second is law and ethics: when an accident happens, who bears the responsibility, the owner, the software provider, or the vehicle manufacturer, all need clear definition.

pairs.zh: 此外，数据隐私、职业司机的转岗过渡，也是社会必须正视的问题。
pairs.en: In addition, data privacy and the transition of professional drivers are issues society must face squarely.

pairs.zh: 汽车厂商、保险机构、交通部门之间需要共同摸索，才能建立起一套既鼓励创新又保护公众利益的制度框架。
pairs.en: Automakers, insurers, and traffic authorities need to explore together before a framework can be established that both encourages innovation and protects the public interest.

pairs.zh: 很多司机担心自己的职业会被取代，其实更现实的路径是逐步转型为远程监控员、车辆安全员等新角色。
pairs.en: Many drivers worry their jobs will be replaced; in reality, a more practical path is a gradual transition into new roles such as remote monitors and vehicle safety officers.

pairs.zh: 从长远看，自动驾驶和智能交通的结合，有望让城市变得更宜居。
pairs.en: In the long run, the combination of autonomous driving and intelligent transportation may make cities more livable.

pairs.zh: 人们每天花在路上的时间可以缩短，老人和残疾人出行会更加方便，交通事故造成的伤亡也能显著下降。
pairs.en: The time people spend on the road every day can be shortened, the elderly and the disabled can travel more easily, and casualties from traffic accidents can drop markedly.

pairs.zh: 当然，这一天不会轻易到来，它需要技术、法规、保险、城市规划等多个方面共同努力。
pairs.en: Of course, that day will not come easily; it requires joint efforts across technology, regulation, insurance, and urban planning.

pairs.zh: 对普通人而言，了解这些变化，既是为了更好地迎接未来的出行方式，也是为了在技术走进生活时，能够做出理性而从容的选择，既不盲目恐惧，也不过分乐观。
pairs.en: For ordinary people, understanding these changes is both about better embracing future travel and about making rational, calm choices when the technology arrives, neither blindly fearing it nor being overly optimistic.

pairs.zh: 相信再过十几年，坐在车里看书、办公，把驾驶交给系统，会成为越来越多人习以为常的日常。
pairs.en: I believe that in a dozen or so years, sitting in a car reading or working while handing the driving over to the system will become a commonplace daily routine for more and more people.

pairs.zh: 支撑自动驾驶的硬件，也在悄悄发生变化。
pairs.en: The hardware supporting autonomous driving is also quietly changing.

pairs.zh: 早期的自动驾驶车顶常常顶着一个旋转的传感器，样子有些笨重，成本也很高。
pairs.en: Early autonomous vehicles often carried a rotating sensor on the roof, somewhat bulky and very costly.

pairs.zh: 随着技术进步，这些设备正变得越来越小、越来越便宜，有的干脆被隐藏到车身内部，从外观上几乎看不出来。
pairs.en: As technology advances, these devices are becoming smaller and cheaper, and some are even hidden inside the bodywork, almost invisible from the outside.

pairs.zh: 车辆之间、车辆与路边设施之间也能通过无线网络实时交换信息，前方几公里外发生的事故，后车在出发前就能收到提醒。
pairs.en: Vehicles can also exchange information with roadside facilities in real time over wireless networks, so a car can receive a warning about an accident several kilometers ahead before it even sets off.

pairs.zh: 这种车路协同的思路，比单纯依靠单车智能更稳妥，也更适合我国道路里程长、路况复杂的实际情况。
pairs.en: This idea of vehicle-to-everything coordination is more robust than relying solely on single-vehicle intelligence, and better suited to China's long road network and complex traffic conditions.

pairs.zh: 与此同时，地图公司正在绘制厘米级精度的道路数据，红绿灯、井盖、隔离带都被一一标注，为系统提供可靠的参照。
pairs.en: Meanwhile, mapping companies are drawing centimeter-level road data, marking traffic lights, manhole covers, and median barriers one by one to provide the system with reliable references.

pairs.zh: 技术每往前迈一小步，安全裕度就多增加一分，普通人离放心乘坐的那一天也就更近一步。
pairs.en: With every small step forward in technology, the safety margin grows, and ordinary people come one step closer to the day they can ride with peace of mind.

pairs.zh: 在政策引导方面，国内多个城市已经开通了智能网联汽车的测试道路和示范运营区。
pairs.en: In terms of policy guidance, many cities in China have already opened test roads and demonstration zones for intelligent connected vehicles.

pairs.zh: 管理部门为测试车辆发放专用牌照，要求企业配备安全员，并定期上报运行数据。
pairs.en: Regulators issue special plates for test vehicles, require companies to deploy safety officers, and ask for regular reports of operating data.

pairs.zh: 这样既给了创新者试错的空间，又把风险控制在可接受的范围。
pairs.en: In this way, innovators are given room to try and fail while risks are kept within an acceptable range.

pairs.zh: 一些港口、机场、矿区还率先实现了封闭式场景的无人化作业，司机从驾驶室里走了出来，转而坐在监控中心远程照看多辆车。
pairs.en: Some ports, airports, and mining areas have even taken the lead in unmanned operations in enclosed scenarios: drivers have stepped out of the cab and now sit in monitoring centers, overseeing multiple vehicles remotely.

pairs.zh: 这种渐进式的推广路径，既符合技术成熟的规律，也照顾了社会的接受度。
pairs.en: This incremental path of promotion fits both the pattern of technological maturity and society's readiness.

pairs.zh: 可以预期，未来十年里，我们会在越来越多的城市街头见到没有司机的车辆安静地驶过，而人们对它们的态度，也会从最初的好奇与观望，逐渐变成习以为常的信任与依赖。
pairs.en: It can be expected that in the coming decade, we will see driverless vehicles quietly passing on the streets of more and more cities, and people's attitude toward them will gradually shift from initial curiosity and hesitation to habitual trust and reliance.

pairs.zh: 这一变化不仅会重塑交通出行，也会改变城市的空间布局，让马路变得更安静、更安全、更有人情味。
pairs.en: This change will not only reshape transportation but also alter the spatial layout of cities, making streets quieter, safer, and more humane.

pairs.zh: 机器人早已不是科幻电影里的专属形象，它正悄悄走进工厂、仓库、医院和家庭。
pairs.en: Robots are no longer exclusive figures in science-fiction films; they are quietly entering factories, warehouses, hospitals, and homes.

pairs.zh: 在流水线上，机械臂可以不知疲倦地重复焊接、喷涂、装配等动作，精度远远超过人手；
pairs.en: On assembly lines, robotic arms can tirelessly repeat welding, spraying, and assembly movements with precision far beyond human hands;

pairs.zh: 在仓库里，自动搬运小车沿着地面上的二维码来回穿梭，把货物送到分拣台；
pairs.en: in warehouses, automatic transport carts shuttle back and forth along QR codes on the floor, delivering goods to sorting stations;

pairs.zh: 在医院里，机器人可以辅助医生完成精细的手术，也可以在药房里快速取药。
pairs.en: in hospitals, robots can assist doctors in delicate surgeries and quickly fetch medicines in the pharmacy.

pairs.zh: 这些设备共同构成了智能制造的基础。
pairs.en: These devices together form the foundation of intelligent manufacturing.

pairs.zh: 如今，不少餐厅也引入了送餐机器人，它们端着盘子在餐桌间灵活避让，成为店里一道有趣的风景。
pairs.en: Today, many restaurants have also introduced food-delivery robots that weave deftly between tables with trays, becoming an amusing sight in the establishment.

pairs.zh: 一些农场甚至用机器人采摘水果、修剪枝叶，把农民从弯腰劳作中解放出来。
pairs.en: Some farms even use robots to pick fruit and trim branches, freeing farmers from stooping labor.

pairs.zh: 所谓智能制造，简单说就是让生产系统学会思考。
pairs.en: Intelligent manufacturing, in simple terms, means making production systems learn to think.

pairs.zh: 传统的生产线只能按照固定流程运转，换一种产品就要重新调整设备。
pairs.en: Traditional production lines can only run according to fixed processes, and switching to a different product requires reconfiguring the equipment.

pairs.zh: 而智能工厂里的机器之间能够互相通信，订单来了之后，系统会自动安排物料、调配机器、监控质量，并在出现异常时及时报警。
pairs.en: In smart factories, machines can communicate with one another: when an order arrives, the system automatically arranges materials, assigns machines, monitors quality, and raises timely alarms when something goes wrong.

pairs.zh: 这样一来，小批量、多品种的定制化生产也能做到又快又省，企业可以更快地响应市场变化。
pairs.en: As a result, small-batch, multi-variety customized production can be both fast and economical, letting companies respond to market changes more quickly.

pairs.zh: 消费者在网上下单定制一双鞋，工厂就能按照每个人的脚型安排生产，几天之后送货上门。
pairs.en: When a consumer orders a customized pair of shoes online, the factory can arrange production according to each person's foot shape and deliver them to the door a few days later.

pairs.zh: 车间里的每一台设备都带着传感器，一旦振动或温度出现异常，维护人员会提前收到提醒，把故障消灭在萌芽状态。
pairs.en: Every machine in the workshop carries sensors; once vibration or temperature goes abnormal, maintenance staff receive an early warning, nipping faults in the bud.

pairs.zh: 机器人之所以越来越聪明，离不开几方面技术的进步。
pairs.en: Robots are becoming smarter thanks to progress in several areas of technology.

pairs.zh: 一是传感器更加灵敏，机器能像人一样看到、听到、摸到周围的环境；
pairs.en: First, sensors are more sensitive, letting machines see, hear, and touch their surroundings like humans;

pairs.zh: 二是计算能力更加强大，收集到的海量数据可以被实时分析；
pairs.en: second, computing power is stronger, so the massive data collected can be analyzed in real time;

pairs.zh: 三是人工智能算法不断成熟，让机器具备了一定的学习和判断能力。
pairs.en: third, AI algorithms keep maturing, giving machines a degree of learning and judgment.

pairs.zh: 这些进步叠加在一起，使机器人从过去只会干粗重活，逐渐开始承担需要细致观察和灵活决策的任务。
pairs.en: These advances together have let robots move from doing only heavy, rough work to gradually taking on tasks that require careful observation and flexible decisions.

pairs.zh: 一些协作型机器人甚至可以和工人并肩作业，安全地与人共处一个工位，一旦碰到人体就会立刻停下，不必再用安全栅栏隔开。
pairs.en: Some collaborative robots can even work side by side with workers, safely sharing a workstation with people, stopping immediately upon contact with a human body so that safety fences are no longer needed.

pairs.zh: 不过，智能制造并不意味着把工人全部替换掉。
pairs.en: However, intelligent manufacturing does not mean replacing all workers.

pairs.zh: 相反，它把人从危险、重复、繁重的岗位上解放出来，让人去做更有创造力的工作，比如设计新产品、维护设备、优化流程。
pairs.en: On the contrary, it frees people from dangerous, repetitive, and heavy posts, letting them do more creative work such as designing new products, maintaining equipment, and optimizing processes.

pairs.zh: 操作机器人、调试生产线、解读数据报表，这些新岗位需要工人接受再培训。
pairs.en: Operating robots, debugging production lines, and interpreting data reports, these new posts require workers to receive retraining.

pairs.zh: 许多工厂已经和职业学校合作，开设了自动化、工业软件等课程，帮助劳动者跟上技术变革的节奏。
pairs.en: Many factories have already partnered with vocational schools to offer courses in automation and industrial software, helping workers keep pace with technological change.

pairs.zh: 一名熟练的老钳工，经过培训后成长为设备维护工程师，这样的故事在今天并不少见。
pairs.en: A skilled veteran fitter growing into an equipment maintenance engineer through training is not a rare story today.

pairs.zh: 企业也意识到，培养自己的技术骨干，比一味购买昂贵设备更有长远价值。
pairs.en: Companies have also realized that cultivating their own technical backbone holds more long-term value than simply buying expensive equipment.

pairs.zh: 展望未来，机器人的形态还会更加多样。
pairs.en: Looking ahead, the forms of robots will become even more diverse.

pairs.zh: 有的会像灵巧的助手一样走进家庭，帮忙打扫、做饭、陪伴老人；
pairs.en: Some will enter homes as agile assistants, helping with cleaning, cooking, and companionship for the elderly;

pairs.zh: 有的会深入海底和太空，执行人类难以抵达的任务。
pairs.en: some will go deep under the sea and into space to carry out missions humans find hard to reach.

pairs.zh: 智能制造则会让工厂更绿色、更柔性，用更少的能源和材料生产出更好的产品。
pairs.en: Intelligent manufacturing will make factories greener and more flexible, producing better products with less energy and fewer materials.

pairs.zh: 对国家而言，牢牢掌握机器人和智能制造的核心技术，是提升制造业竞争力、保障就业质量的关键一步，也是普通人分享技术红利的重要途径。
pairs.en: For a country, firmly grasping the core technologies of robots and intelligent manufacturing is a key step in enhancing manufacturing competitiveness and safeguarding the quality of employment, and an important route for ordinary people to share in the dividends of technology.

pairs.zh: 当机器人不再是冰冷的机器，而是可靠的伙伴，整个社会的生产和生活方式都将迎来深刻而温暖的变化。
pairs.en: When robots are no longer cold machines but reliable partners, the way society produces and lives will undergo profound and warm changes.

pairs.zh: 中国制造要走向中国智造，靠的正是一代又一代工匠与工程师的智慧和汗水。
pairs.en: Moving from Made in China to Intelligently Made in China rests precisely on the wisdom and sweat of generation after generation of craftsmen and engineers.

pairs.zh: 值得一提的是，机器人和智能制造并不只是大企业的专利。
pairs.en: It is worth mentioning that robots and intelligent manufacturing are not exclusive to large enterprises.

pairs.zh: 如今不少中小企业也开始用得起自动化设备，一台小型协作机器人的价格，往往相当于一两名工人一年的工资，而它可以连续工作多年。
pairs.en: Today, many small and medium enterprises can also afford automation equipment; a small collaborative robot often costs about the same as the annual salary of one or two workers, yet it can work continuously for years.

pairs.zh: 更重要的是，工业软件的进步让中小企业也能共享过去只有大工厂才用得起的设计和管理工具。
pairs.en: More importantly, advances in industrial software let smaller firms share design and management tools that only large factories could afford in the past.

pairs.zh: 从接单、排产到发货，整个流程在电脑上一目了然，物料积压和交货延迟都能明显减少。
pairs.en: From taking orders and scheduling production to shipping, the whole process is visible at a glance on a computer, and both material backlog and delivery delays can be markedly reduced.

pairs.zh: 在一些产业集群里，几十家小企业通过共享平台协同生产，你做外壳、我做电路、他做组装，像一条看不见的流水线。
pairs.en: In some industrial clusters, dozens of small enterprises cooperate through shared platforms, one making shells, another circuits, another assembly, like an invisible production line.

pairs.zh: 这种柔性的制造模式，让中国制造业的毛细血管更加灵活，也让更多普通劳动者有机会参与到高质量生产当中。
pairs.en: This flexible manufacturing model makes the capillaries of China's manufacturing sector nimbler and gives more ordinary workers a chance to take part in high-quality production.

pairs.zh: 从教育和人才培养的角度看，机器人产业还在催生一批全新的职业。
pairs.en: From the perspective of education and talent cultivation, the robotics industry is also giving birth to a whole range of brand-new occupations.

pairs.zh: 机器人调试员、数字孪生工程师、工业数据分析师，这些岗位在十年前几乎闻所未闻，如今却成了招聘市场上的热门。
pairs.en: Robot debuggers, digital-twin engineers, and industrial data analysts were almost unheard of ten years ago, yet today they are hot jobs on the recruitment market.

pairs.zh: 职业院校纷纷开办机器人相关专业，学生在校期间既要学机械电气，也要学编程和数据分析，毕业时才能真正胜任现场工作。
pairs.en: Vocational colleges have opened robotics programs one after another; students must learn both mechanical and electrical skills and programming and data analysis so that they can truly handle on-site work upon graduation.

pairs.zh: 与此同时，老一辈产业工人也没有被遗忘，许多企业开展了在岗培训，让老师傅掌握新工具，把多年的经验和新的技术结合起来。
pairs.en: At the same time, the older generation of industrial workers has not been forgotten; many enterprises offer on-the-job training so that veteran workers master new tools and combine years of experience with new technology.

pairs.zh: 智能制造归根到底是为人服务的，机器再聪明，也离不开人的判断、维护和改进。
pairs.en: Intelligent manufacturing, in the final analysis, serves people; however smart machines become, they still rely on human judgment, maintenance, and improvement.

pairs.zh: 只有让劳动者与技术共同成长，这场变革才能真正惠及每一个家庭，让制造业成为既有竞争力、又有温度的立国之本。
pairs.en: Only when workers and technology grow together can this transformation truly benefit every family, making manufacturing a pillar of the nation that is both competitive and humane.

pairs.zh: 放眼未来，中国不仅要做制造大国，更要做制造强国，而机器人与智能制造，正是通往这一目标最坚实的阶梯。
pairs.en: Looking to the future, China aims not only to be a manufacturing powerhouse in scale but in strength, and robots and intelligent manufacturing are the most solid ladder to that goal.

pairs.zh: 让我们以开放的心态拥抱变化，用智慧和汗水共同迎接一个更加智能、更加美好的工业新时代。
pairs.en: Let us embrace change with an open mind and work with wisdom and sweat to welcome a smarter and better new era of industry.

pairs.zh: 虚拟现实是一种让人沉浸到计算机生成环境中的技术。
pairs.en: Virtual reality is a technology that immerses people in computer-generated environments.

pairs.zh: 使用者戴上特制的眼镜，眼前就会出现一个三维空间，可以四处张望、自由走动；
pairs.en: When users put on special glasses, a three-dimensional space appears before their eyes, and they can look around and move about freely;

pairs.zh: 手里握着感应手柄，就能虚拟地拿起物体、按下按钮。
pairs.en: holding sensing handles, they can virtually pick up objects and press buttons.

pairs.zh: 除了视觉，不少设备还会提供声音、震动甚至气味反馈，让人产生身临其境的感觉。
pairs.en: Beyond vision, many devices also provide sound, vibration, and even smell feedback, creating a feeling of being there.

pairs.zh: 这项技术最初多用于游戏和娱乐，如今正逐渐走进教育、医疗、工程、训练等更广阔的领域。
pairs.en: Originally used mostly for games and entertainment, the technology is now gradually entering broader fields such as education, healthcare, engineering, and training.

pairs.zh: 许多人第一次戴上眼镜时，都会忍不住伸手去抓眼前那只并不存在的杯子，那种真实感让人惊讶。
pairs.en: When many people put on the glasses for the first time, they cannot help reaching for a cup that does not actually exist, and that sense of realism is astonishing.

pairs.zh: 短短几分钟里，人们仿佛从拥挤的客厅瞬移到了高山之巅或海底世界。
pairs.en: In just a few minutes, people seem to teleport from a crowded living room to the summit of a mountain or the depths of the sea.

pairs.zh: 在课堂上，学生可以走进虚拟的古埃及金字塔，近距离观察壁画；
pairs.en: In the classroom, students can step inside a virtual pyramid of ancient Egypt and observe the murals up close;

pairs.zh: 可以钻进人体内部，看血液如何在血管中流动。
pairs.en: they can dive inside the human body and watch how blood flows through vessels.

pairs.zh: 这种直观的体验，比书本上的图片更容易让人记住知识。
pairs.en: This kind of intuitive experience makes knowledge easier to remember than pictures in books.

pairs.zh: 在医学培训中，年轻医生可以在虚拟病人身上反复练习手术步骤，不必担心失误带来的后果。
pairs.en: In medical training, young doctors can repeatedly practice surgical steps on virtual patients without worrying about the consequences of mistakes.

pairs.zh: 在工程设计里，设计师可以提前走进还没建好的大楼，检验采光和动线是否合理，从而节省大量修改成本。
pairs.en: In engineering design, designers can walk through a building that has not yet been built, checking whether lighting and traffic flow are reasonable, thereby saving a great deal of modification cost.
