pairs.zh: 飞行员和消防员也常用类似的模拟设备进行演练，在安全的环境中积累应对紧急情况的经验。
pairs.en: Pilots and firefighters also often train with similar simulators, accumulating experience in handling emergencies in a safe environment.

pairs.zh: 一些博物馆还把珍贵展品数字化，让远隔千里的观众也能走近细看。
pairs.en: Some museums have also digitized precious exhibits, letting audiences thousands of miles away get close for a careful look.

pairs.zh: 所谓元宇宙，可以理解为虚拟现实技术进一步发展后形成的一个网络化的虚拟世界。
pairs.en: The metaverse can be understood as a networked virtual world formed after virtual reality develops further.

pairs.zh: 在那里，人们以虚拟形象相聚，开会、看展、购物、社交，彼此之间的互动像现实中一样自然。
pairs.en: There, people gather as virtual avatars to hold meetings, view exhibitions, shop, and socialize, with interactions as natural as in real life.

pairs.zh: 元宇宙并不是单一公司的产品，而是一个由许多平台共同构成的数字空间，它强调持久、开放和互通，今天放下的东西，明天还在；
pairs.en: The metaverse is not the product of a single company but a digital space jointly formed by many platforms; it emphasizes persistence, openness, and interoperability, so what you put down today is still there tomorrow;

pairs.zh: 这个身份，在那个平台也能被认出。
pairs.en: and this identity can also be recognized on that other platform.

pairs.zh: 远方的亲友即使相隔千里，也能坐在同一个虚拟的客厅里喝茶聊天，这种体验比打视频电话多了一份共处的温暖。
pairs.en: Distant relatives, even thousands of miles apart, can sit in the same virtual living room drinking tea and chatting, an experience that carries a warmth of togetherness that video calls lack.

pairs.zh: 艺术家也可以在虚拟展厅里举办展览，观众来自世界各地，却仿佛挤在同一间画廊里。
pairs.en: Artists can also hold exhibitions in virtual galleries where audiences come from all over the world yet feel crowded into the same gallery.

pairs.zh: 要让元宇宙真正普及，还需要跨过几道坎。
pairs.en: For the metaverse to truly become widespread, several hurdles must be crossed.

pairs.zh: 一是设备要更轻便、更便宜，长时间佩戴不能让人头晕；
pairs.en: First, devices must be lighter and cheaper, and long wear must not cause dizziness;

pairs.zh: 二是网络要更快更稳，否则画面卡顿会立刻破坏沉浸感；
pairs.en: second, networks must be faster and more stable, or janky pictures will instantly destroy immersion;

pairs.zh: 三是内容要足够丰富，否则用户新鲜劲一过就会离开。
pairs.en: third, content must be rich enough, or users will leave once the novelty wears off.

pairs.zh: 此外，虚拟世界里同样会遇到隐私、沉迷、消费纠纷等问题，规则和保护机制必须跟上。
pairs.en: In addition, the virtual world also faces problems such as privacy, addiction, and consumption disputes, so rules and protection mechanisms must keep up.

pairs.zh: 如果一个孩子在虚拟世界里花掉了家长大笔积蓄，平台应当有相应的冷静期和退款渠道，这一点已经开始引起监管部门的重视。
pairs.en: If a child spends a large amount of a parent's savings in the virtual world, the platform should provide an appropriate cooling-off period and refund channel, an issue that regulators have begun to take seriously.

pairs.zh: 虚拟土地和数字藏品的价格波动也很大，普通投资者应当理性看待，不要盲目跟风。
pairs.en: The prices of virtual land and digital collectibles also fluctuate wildly, and ordinary investors should view them rationally and not blindly follow the trend.

pairs.zh: 对普通人来说，不必把元宇宙想象得过于遥远或神秘。
pairs.en: For ordinary people, there is no need to imagine the metaverse as too distant or mysterious.

pairs.zh: 它更像是互联网发展的下一个阶段，把二维的屏幕交流，逐步升级为更有临场感的三维互动。
pairs.en: It is more like the next stage of Internet development, gradually upgrading two-dimensional screen communication into more immersive three-dimensional interaction.

pairs.zh: 今天我们用视频会议远程办公，明天也许就能走进同一个虚拟会议室，和远方的同事围坐一桌。
pairs.en: Today we work remotely through video conferences; tomorrow we may walk into the same virtual meeting room and sit around a table with colleagues far away.

pairs.zh: 理解这一趋势，提前尝试相关的应用，有助于我们在数字生活不断延伸的过程中，既享受便利，又保持理性，不让技术占据过多本该属于现实生活的时间。
pairs.en: Understanding this trend and trying relevant applications early can help us, as digital life keeps expanding, enjoy convenience while staying rational, and not let technology take up time that should belong to real life.

pairs.zh: 虚拟世界再精彩，终究是现实生活的延伸和补充，而不是替代品。
pairs.en: However wonderful the virtual world is, it is ultimately an extension and supplement of real life, not a substitute.

pairs.zh: 学会在两个世界之间自如切换，是这一代人和下一代人都要面对的新课题。
pairs.en: Learning to switch freely between the two worlds is a new challenge facing this generation and the next.

pairs.zh: 在体验方面，虚拟技术也在不断改进。
pairs.en: In terms of experience, virtual technology is also constantly improving.

pairs.zh: 最早的头盔又大又重，戴半小时就会满头大汗，画面分辨率也不够高，看久了容易头晕。
pairs.en: The earliest headsets were big and heavy, making users sweat after half an hour, and the resolution was not high enough, easily causing dizziness after long viewing.

pairs.zh: 如今的设备已经轻巧许多，画面也越来越清晰，配上动作捕捉手套，甚至能感受到虚拟物体的形状和重量。
pairs.en: Today's devices are much lighter, the picture is increasingly clear, and with motion-capture gloves, users can even feel the shape and weight of virtual objects.

pairs.zh: 一些科研团队还在研究气味、温度和微风的模拟，希望有一天能让虚拟体验从视听扩展到全身。
pairs.en: Some research teams are also working on simulating smells, temperature, and breezes, hoping that one day virtual experiences can extend from sight and sound to the whole body.

pairs.zh: 当然，再好的技术也需要节制。
pairs.en: Of course, even the best technology requires moderation.

pairs.zh: 医生提醒，未成年人长时间沉浸在虚拟环境中，可能影响视力和社交能力，家长应当帮助孩子合理安排使用时间。
pairs.en: Doctors remind us that minors immersed in virtual environments for long periods may have their eyesight and social skills affected, and parents should help children arrange their usage time sensibly.

pairs.zh: 虚拟世界为我们打开了一扇窗，但窗外的阳光、风吹和亲人的笑脸，依然是真实生活中最值得珍惜的部分。
pairs.en: The virtual world opens a window for us, but the sunlight, the breeze, and the smiling faces of loved ones outside the window are still the most precious parts of real life.

pairs.zh: 从产业发展的角度看，虚拟现实和元宇宙带动了一整条新的产业链。
pairs.en: From the perspective of industrial development, virtual reality and the metaverse have driven an entire new industrial chain.

pairs.zh: 上游有显示屏、芯片、传感器的研发制造，中游有内容创作平台和引擎工具，下游则是教育培训、文旅展示、虚拟社交等应用场景。
pairs.en: Upstream, there is the R&D and manufacturing of displays, chips, and sensors; in the middle, there are content creation platforms and engine tools; and downstream are application scenarios such as education and training, cultural tourism displays, and virtual socializing.

pairs.zh: 国内不少科技公司已经在这一领域布局，既做硬件，也做内容，还举办了多场虚拟演唱会和虚拟展会。
pairs.en: Many domestic tech companies have already positioned themselves in this field, making hardware and content alike and hosting multiple virtual concerts and virtual exhibitions.

pairs.zh: 对普通创作者而言，这意味着新的机会，有人把自己的画做成虚拟展品，有人在虚拟空间里教外国人学中文。
pairs.en: For ordinary creators, this means new opportunities: some turn their paintings into virtual exhibits, and some teach foreigners Chinese in virtual spaces.

pairs.zh: 未来，虚拟世界可能会像今天的移动互联网一样，成为人们工作和生活的常规组成部分。
pairs.en: In the future, the virtual world may become as routine a part of people's work and life as the mobile Internet is today.

pairs.zh: 关键在于，我们要以开放而审慎的心态去拥抱它，既不被炒作的概念牵着走，也不因为暂时的不成熟就否定它长远的价值。
pairs.en: The key is to embrace it with an open yet prudent mindset, neither being led by the nose by hyped concepts nor denying its long-term value because it is not yet mature.

pairs.zh: 说到底，技术只是工具，真正决定我们能走多远的，依然是想象力、创造力以及对美好生活的向往。
pairs.en: In the end, technology is only a tool; what truly determines how far we can go is still imagination, creativity, and the longing for a better life.

pairs.zh: 愿我们都能在虚实之间找到平衡，既享受科技带来的新奇体验，也珍惜眼前真实的人间烟火与身边的亲朋好友，让技术为生活添彩，而不是喧宾夺主。
pairs.en: May we all find balance between the virtual and the real, enjoying the novel experiences technology brings while cherishing the real-life human warmth and the friends and family around us, letting technology add color to life rather than steal the show.

pairs.zh: 今天的生活几乎已经离不开网络。
pairs.en: Life today can hardly do without the Internet.

pairs.zh: 我们用手机付款、用导航出行、在云端存储照片和文件，企业通过网络连接客户、工厂和仓库，政府也把大量公共服务搬到了线上。
pairs.en: We pay with our phones, navigate with maps, and store photos and files in the cloud; businesses connect customers, factories, and warehouses through networks, and governments have moved much of public service online.

pairs.zh: 网络带来便利的同时，也让安全问题变得前所未有的重要。
pairs.en: While the Internet brings convenience, it also makes security issues more important than ever.

pairs.zh: 一次小小的密码泄露，可能导致账户被盗；
pairs.en: A single small password leak can lead to a stolen account;

pairs.zh: 一处系统漏洞，可能让成千上万人的隐私曝光。
pairs.en: a single system vulnerability can expose the privacy of tens of thousands of people.

pairs.zh: 网络安全和数据安全，已经成为每个人都需要关心的事，而不再只是技术部门的专属话题。
pairs.en: Cybersecurity and data security have become concerns for everyone, no longer a topic exclusive to technology departments.

pairs.zh: 早上醒来刷手机、中午扫码点外卖、晚上回家看在线视频，每一次联网都在产生数据，也都在与看不见的风险擦肩而过。
pairs.en: From scrolling phones when waking up, to scanning QR codes for lunch, to watching online videos at night, every connection generates data and brushes past invisible risks.

pairs.zh: 网络攻击的形式多种多样。
pairs.en: Cyberattacks take many forms.

pairs.zh: 有人伪装成银行或客服发来短信，诱导你点击链接输入密码，这就是常见的钓鱼手段。
pairs.en: Some people disguise themselves as banks or customer service and send text messages that lure you into clicking links and entering passwords; this is the common practice of phishing.

pairs.zh: 有人给电脑植入恶意程序，把文件加密锁住，直到收到赎金才肯解开。
pairs.en: Some plant malicious programs on computers, encrypting files and locking them until a ransom is paid to unlock them.

pairs.zh: 还有人集中访问某个网站，让服务器瞬间瘫痪，使正常用户无法使用。
pairs.en: Still others flood a website with concentrated visits, paralyzing its servers instantly and making it unusable for normal users.

pairs.zh: 面对这些威胁，企业和机构需要做好防火墙、入侵检测、数据备份等多层防护，而普通人也需要养成良好的使用习惯。
pairs.en: Facing these threats, businesses and institutions need multi-layered defenses such as firewalls, intrusion detection, and data backup, while ordinary people also need good usage habits.

pairs.zh: 例如收到陌生链接时多问一句来源，不在来路不明的软件里填写真实信息，定期更新手机和电脑的系统补丁。
pairs.en: For example, ask about the source when receiving unfamiliar links, never enter real information on software of unknown origin, and regularly update system patches on phones and computers.

pairs.zh: 不少攻击之所以得逞，恰恰是因为用户图一时方便，把密码设得过于简单。
pairs.en: Many attacks succeed precisely because users set passwords too simply for convenience.

pairs.zh: 保护数据安全，首先要分清哪些信息是敏感的。
pairs.en: To protect data security, the first step is to know which information is sensitive.

pairs.zh: 身份证号、银行卡号、家庭住址、健康记录、聊天内容，这些都属于个人隐私。
pairs.en: ID numbers, bank card numbers, home addresses, health records, and chat content all count as personal privacy.

pairs.zh: 正规的商家不会随意索要这些信息，凡是来电来信主动询问的，都要多留一个心眼。
pairs.en: Legitimate businesses will not ask for such information casually; any call or message that proactively asks for it deserves extra caution.

pairs.zh: 设置密码时，不要图省事用生日或连续数字，最好不同账号使用不同密码，并开启两步验证。
pairs.en: When setting passwords, do not take shortcuts with birthdays or consecutive numbers; ideally use different passwords for different accounts and enable two-step verification.

pairs.zh: 公共场合的无线网络不要用来登录重要账户，以免被人窃听。
pairs.en: Do not log into important accounts over public wireless networks, lest you be eavesdropped.

pairs.zh: 快递单、机票存根上印着姓名和电话，扔之前最好把这些信息涂黑，多一个小动作就多一层保护。
pairs.en: Express slips and boarding-pass stubs carry names and phone numbers; it is best to black out such information before throwing them away, and one small extra step means one more layer of protection.

pairs.zh: 接到自称公检法要求转账的电话，几乎可以断定是诈骗，立刻挂断并向家人核实。
pairs.en: If you receive a call claiming to be from the police or prosecutors demanding a transfer, you can almost be sure it is fraud; hang up immediately and verify with family.

pairs.zh: 从国家和社会层面看，数据安全更是一项系统工程。
pairs.en: At the national and social level, data security is even more of a systematic project.

pairs.zh: 近年来，我国陆续出台了网络安全法、数据安全法、个人信息保护法等一系列法律法规，明确了收集和使用个人信息的边界，要求企业在收集数据时遵循最小必要原则，不能超范围索取，不能随意倒卖。
pairs.en: In recent years, China has successively issued a series of laws and regulations such as the Cybersecurity Law, the Data Security Law, and the Personal Information Protection Law, clarifying the boundaries for collecting and using personal information and requiring enterprises to follow the principle of minimal necessity when collecting data, without over-collecting or reselling it at will.

pairs.zh: 监管部门还开展了针对违规应用、过度索权、大数据杀熟等行为的整治，让用户的知情权和选择权得到更好保障。
pairs.en: Regulators have also carried out crackdowns on problematic apps, excessive permission requests, and big-data price discrimination against regular users, giving users' right to know and right to choose better protection.

pairs.zh: 一款购物软件如果非要读取通讯录才能使用，用户就有权拒绝，并向有关部门反映。
pairs.en: If a shopping app insists on reading your contacts before it can be used, users have the right to refuse and report it to the authorities.

pairs.zh: 重要行业还建立了网络安全审查制度，关键基础设施必须通过严格检查才能上线运行。
pairs.en: Important industries have also established cybersecurity review systems, and critical infrastructure must pass strict inspections before going online.

pairs.zh: 对企业而言，安全投入不是成本，而是信誉。
pairs.en: For enterprises, security spending is not a cost but a matter of reputation.

pairs.zh: 一旦发生大规模泄露事故，失去的用户信任往往需要多年才能挽回。
pairs.en: Once a large-scale leak occurs, the user trust lost often takes years to win back.

pairs.zh: 理想的做法，是在设计产品之初就把安全考虑进去，定期开展演练和检查，及时修补漏洞，并对员工进行保密培训。
pairs.en: The ideal approach is to build security into products from the design stage, conduct regular drills and inspections, patch vulnerabilities promptly, and train employees in confidentiality.

pairs.zh: 对个人而言，多一份警惕，就少一分风险。
pairs.en: For individuals, a little more vigilance means a little less risk.

pairs.zh: 网络空间不是法外之地，数据也不是可以随意处置的商品。
pairs.en: Cyberspace is not a lawless land, and data is not a commodity to be disposed of at will.

pairs.zh: 只有每个人、每家企业、每个部门都守好自己的一道防线，整个数字社会才能在安全的轨道上稳步向前发展，让技术真正服务于人，而不是反过来让人暴露在风险之中。
pairs.en: Only when every individual, every company, and every department guards its own line of defense can the entire digital society advance steadily on a safe track, letting technology truly serve people rather than exposing them to risk.

pairs.zh: 安全与发展从来不是对立的两面，而是相辅相成、缺一不可的整体。
pairs.en: Security and development have never been opposites; they are mutually reinforcing and inseparable.

pairs.zh: 从技术手段看，保护数据也有一些成熟的做法。
pairs.en: From a technical standpoint, there are also mature practices for protecting data.

pairs.zh: 重要文件应当定期备份，并且备份要和日常使用的电脑分开存放，这样即使中了勒索病毒，也不至于束手无策。
pairs.en: Important files should be backed up regularly, and backups should be stored separately from the computers used daily, so that even if hit by ransomware, you are not left helpless.

pairs.zh: 传输敏感信息时，尽量使用经过加密的通道，避免在公开论坛或聊天群里随意转发包含身份证号的表格。
pairs.en: When transmitting sensitive information, try to use encrypted channels and avoid casually forwarding tables containing ID numbers in public forums or chat groups.

pairs.zh: 企业内部还要做到权限分级，普通员工看不到与自己工作无关的客户资料，一旦账号失窃，损失范围也能被限制在最小。
pairs.en: Within enterprises, permissions should also be graded so that ordinary employees cannot see customer information unrelated to their work, and if an account is stolen, the scope of loss can be kept to a minimum.

pairs.zh: 近年来，威胁情报共享、安全众测、白帽子黑客等机制也逐渐普及，全社会正在形成一张共同防御的网。
pairs.en: In recent years, mechanisms such as threat-intelligence sharing, security crowdsourcing, and white-hat hacking have gradually become common, and society as a whole is forming a web of joint defense.

pairs.zh: 安全不是一劳永逸的事情，而是一场需要持续投入、久久为功的长跑，唯有常抓不懈，才能让我们在享受数字便利的同时，睡得踏实、用得安心。
pairs.en: Security is not a one-time achievement but a long race that requires sustained investment and persistent effort; only by staying diligent can we sleep soundly and use our devices with peace of mind while enjoying digital convenience.

pairs.zh: 回顾这些年的实践，公众的安全意识确实在不断提高。
pairs.en: Looking back at these years of practice, the public's security awareness has indeed been rising.

pairs.zh: 早些年，不少人轻易就把验证码告诉陌生人，结果积蓄被转走；
pairs.en: In earlier years, many people readily told strangers their verification codes, and their savings were transferred away;

pairs.zh: 如今大家接到可疑电话，第一反应是挂断并提醒家人。
pairs.en: today, upon receiving a suspicious call, people's first reaction is to hang up and alert their families.

pairs.zh: 监管部门也通过案例剖析、公益广告、进校园进社区等方式，把防骗知识送到普通人身边。
pairs.en: Regulators have also used case analyses, public-service ads, and campaigns in schools and communities to bring anti-fraud knowledge to ordinary people.

pairs.zh: 银行在转账环节增加了延时到账和弹窗提醒，应用商店对违规收集信息的软件进行下架处理，这些看似细小的举措，叠加起来就构筑了一道坚固的防线。
pairs.en: Banks have added delayed transfers and pop-up warnings at the transfer step, and app stores take down apps that violate rules on information collection; these seemingly small measures, combined, build a solid line of defense.

pairs.zh: 网络安全和数据安全，说到底是为了让人更安心地生活。
pairs.en: Cybersecurity and data security, in the final analysis, are about letting people live more securely.

pairs.zh: 当每一次扫码、每一笔支付、每一次上传都有章可循、有据可查，数字经济的发展才能真正行稳致远，成为全体人民共享的福祉。
pairs.en: When every scan, every payment, and every upload follows rules and leaves verifiable records, the digital economy can truly go far and steadily, becoming a benefit shared by all people.

pairs.zh: 这条路没有终点，需要我们每个人保持警觉、持续学习，与社会各界一同守护好这片共同的数字家园，让未来的数字生活更加安全、更加美好。
pairs.en: This road has no finish line; it requires each of us to stay vigilant and keep learning, guarding this shared digital home together with all sectors of society, so that future digital life becomes safer and better.

pairs.zh: 在远古时代，人们并没有专门用来买卖的东西，彼此之间若想换取物品，只能靠以物易物。
pairs.en: In ancient times, people had nothing specially used for buying and selling, and if they wanted to exchange goods with one another, they could only resort to barter.

pairs.zh: 比如养羊的人需要盐，就牵着羊去找有盐的人商量，看双方能不能谈成。
pairs.en: For example, a sheep herder who needed salt would lead a sheep to find the salt owner and discuss whether the two sides could reach a deal.

pairs.zh: 这种做法看似简单，实际却很不方便，因为交换能否成立，取决于双方正好都需要对方手里的东西，这种巧合并不常有。
pairs.en: This practice seems simple but is actually very inconvenient, because whether an exchange works depends on both sides happening to need what the other holds, and such coincidence is rare.

pairs.zh: 一头羊换来的盐往往太多，一个人一次吃不完，可羊又不能切成好几块慢慢换，这就让大额和小额的交易都很难做下去。
pairs.en: The salt obtained for one sheep is often too much for one person to consume at a time, yet a sheep cannot be cut into pieces to trade gradually, making both large and small transactions hard to complete.

pairs.zh: 养羊的人也许今天想换一把石斧，明天想换几斗粮食，偏偏手里牵的是活羊，总不能每次都牵着它四处奔走。
pairs.en: The sheep herder might want to trade for a stone axe today and a few bushels of grain tomorrow, but what he holds is a live sheep, and he cannot drag it around everywhere every time.

pairs.zh: 随着交换越来越频繁，人们渐渐发现，大家都愿意先把自己的东西换成某种人人都认可的物品，再拿这种物品去换真正需要的货物，货币就这样萌芽了。
pairs.en: As exchanges became more frequent, people gradually found that everyone preferred to first convert their own goods into something universally recognized, and then use that item to obtain what they truly needed; in this way, money sprouted.

pairs.zh: 这种被大家共同接受的中间物，免去了两两巧合的麻烦，让交换变得顺畅起来。
pairs.en: This commonly accepted intermediary spared people the trouble of coincidental matches and made exchange smooth.

pairs.zh: 历史上，牲畜、贝壳、布帛、农具都曾经充当过这样的一般等价物。
pairs.en: In history, livestock, cowrie shells, cloth, and farm tools have all served as such general equivalents.

pairs.zh: 在我国古代，贝壳在很长一段时间里被广泛使用，许多与钱财有关的汉字都带着贝字偏旁，比如买卖、赏赐、贿赂这些字眼，就是这段历史留下的痕迹。
pairs.en: In ancient China, cowrie shells were widely used for a long time, and many Chinese characters related to money carry the cowrie radical, such as the words for buying, selling, rewarding, and bribing, traces left by this history.

pairs.zh: 在有些地方，人们用盐块、用烟草、用毛皮当作交换的媒介，这些东西之所以能被接受，是因为它们本身就有用处，大家心里踏实。
pairs.en: In some places, people used salt blocks, tobacco, and furs as media of exchange; these things were accepted because they had use value of their own, giving everyone peace of mind.

pairs.zh: 后来，随着冶炼技术进步，金属逐渐占据了主导地位，铜、银、金先后成为铸币的材料。
pairs.en: Later, as smelting technology advanced, metals gradually took the lead, and copper, silver, and gold successively became the materials for coined money.

pairs.zh: 金属之所以胜出，是因为它便于分割、便于保存、不容易腐烂，体积小而价值高，正好满足交换的需要。
pairs.en: Metals won because they are easy to divide, easy to store, resistant to decay, and small in volume yet high in value, exactly meeting the needs of exchange.

pairs.zh: 再往后，人们又发明了纸币，最初的纸币不过是一张可以兑换金属货币的凭证，商人把沉甸甸的金属存进钱庄，换来一张轻便的纸票，带着它远行做生意，既安全又省事。
pairs.en: Later still, people invented paper money; the earliest banknotes were merely receipts exchangeable for metal currency, as merchants deposited their heavy metal into money shops and received a light paper note, carrying it on long business trips safely and conveniently.

pairs.zh: 慢慢这张纸票才演变成由国家信用支撑的纸质通货。
pairs.en: Gradually, this paper note evolved into paper currency backed by state credit.

pairs.zh: 今天我们手里的纸币和硬币，已经很少能兑换成真实的金银，但它们依然被普遍接受，原因在于法律规定了它们的偿付地位，也在于大家相信它们明天还能买到东西。
pairs.en: The banknotes and coins in our hands today can rarely be exchanged for real gold or silver, yet they are still universally accepted, because the law grants them legal-tender status and because everyone believes they will still buy things tomorrow.

pairs.zh: 值得一提的是，货币的形态还在继续演变。
pairs.en: It is worth noting that the form of money continues to evolve.

pairs.zh: 如今出门，可以不带一分现金，用手机轻轻一扫就能完成支付，账上的数字一划，买卖就成交了。
pairs.en: Today, one can go out without a single note of cash, complete payment with a light scan of the phone, and the deal is done with a flick of the digits in the account.

pairs.zh: 这些看不见摸不着的电子货币，和纸钞硬币一样发挥着流通手段的作用，甚至更加便捷。
pairs.en: These intangible electronic currencies play the same role as a medium of exchange as paper notes and coins, and are even more convenient.

pairs.zh: 人们渐渐发现，只要大家认可、体系安全，货币究竟是贝壳、是金属、是纸张，还是一串数字，其实并不那么重要，重要的是它能否稳定地充当交换的桥梁。
pairs.en: People have gradually realized that as long as everyone accepts it and the system is safe, it matters little whether money is shells, metal, paper, or a string of digits; what matters is whether it can steadily serve as a bridge of exchange.

pairs.zh: 历史反复证明，当一种货币失去了公众的信任，它就会迅速贬值，沦为一文不值的废纸；
pairs.en: History repeatedly proves that when a currency loses public trust, it rapidly depreciates and becomes worthless paper;

pairs.zh: 而当货币的币值保持稳定，物价平稳，百姓安心储蓄、放心消费，整个经济的齿轮才能顺畅地转动。
pairs.en: and when a currency's value stays stable, prices are steady, and people save with confidence and spend without worry, the gears of the whole economy can turn smoothly.

pairs.zh: 回顾这一漫长过程，我们还能悟出一个朴素的道理：货币从来不是哪个人一拍脑袋凭空发明出来的，而是千百万人在反复交换中共同选择出来的结果。
pairs.en: Reviewing this long process, we can also grasp a simple truth: money was never invented out of thin air by any one person, but is a result jointly chosen by millions of people through repeated exchange.

pairs.zh: 它从大家最需要、最认可的物品中自然脱颖而出，又随着生产和贸易的扩大而不断改进。
pairs.en: It naturally stood out from the goods people needed and recognized most, and kept improving as production and trade expanded.

pairs.zh: 人们选择它，是因为它能减少麻烦、降低成本；
pairs.en: People chose it because it reduces trouble and cost;

pairs.zh: 人们信任它，是因为它一次又一次地完成了媒介的使命。
pairs.en: people trusted it because it fulfilled the mission of a medium time and again.

pairs.zh: 懂得了这一点，再回头看今天钱包里的票子和手机里的数字，就不会把它想得过于神秘，也不会把它看得过于万能。
pairs.en: Once we understand this, looking back at the notes in our wallets and the digits in our phones will neither seem overly mysterious nor all-powerful.

pairs.zh: 要理解货币的本质，可以抓住它的几项基本职能。
pairs.en: To grasp the essence of money, one can focus on its basic functions.

pairs.zh: 首先它是衡量价值的尺子，一件衣服值多少米、多少盐，都可以用货币来表示，这样比较起来就方便多了，谁家东西贵、谁家便宜一目了然。
pairs.en: First, it is a yardstick of value: how much grain or salt a piece of clothing is worth can be expressed in money, making comparison much easier, and it is clear at a glance whose goods are dearer and whose cheaper.

pairs.zh: 其次它是流通的手段，买东西时一手交钱一手交货，货币在其中充当桥梁，卖主不必立刻拿货物去换货物。
pairs.en: Second, it is a medium of circulation: when buying, one hand pays money and the other receives goods, and money serves as the bridge so that sellers need not immediately swap goods for goods.

pairs.zh: 再次它是贮藏财富的仓库，把货币存起来，日后依然可以使用，不必担心像粮食那样放久了会霉坏。
pairs.en: Third, it is a store of wealth: money can be saved and used later, without worrying that it will spoil like stored grain.

pairs.zh: 最后它还能充当延期支付的工具，赊账、还债、发工资、交房租都离不开它。
pairs.en: Finally, it can serve as a tool for deferred payment: credit purchases, debt repayment, wages, and rent all depend on it.

pairs.zh: 这几项职能彼此关联，缺一不可，真正的货币往往同时具备这些本领，缺了哪一样，它在人们心里的地位都会打折扣。
pairs.en: These functions are interrelated and indispensable; true money usually possesses all of them, and lacking any one will discount its standing in people's minds.

pairs.zh: 货币本身并不是财富的全部，它更像是一张提货单，代表着对社会商品和服务的索取权。
pairs.en: Money itself is not the whole of wealth; it is more like a delivery order representing a claim on society's goods and services.

pairs.zh: 一个国家如果随意印发钞票，让票子远远多于真实的商品，物价就会普遍上涨，同样的钱能买到的东西越来越少，这就是通货膨胀，老百姓辛辛苦苦攒下的积蓄会悄悄缩水。
pairs.en: If a country prints notes at will so that the paper far exceeds real goods, prices will rise across the board and the same money will buy less and less; this is inflation, and the savings ordinary people have painfully accumulated will quietly shrink.

pairs.zh: 所以维持货币币值的稳定，是经济健康运转的重要前提，也是当局必须谨慎对待的大事。
pairs.en: Therefore, maintaining the stability of a currency's value is an important precondition for a healthy economy and a major matter that authorities must handle with care.

pairs.zh: 从贝壳到金银，从金属铸币到纸质钞票，再到如今悄然兴起的电子支付，货币的形态一直在变化，可它作为交换媒介和价值尺度的核心作用，几千年来并没有改变。
pairs.en: From shells to gold and silver, from metal coins to paper notes, and on to the quietly rising electronic payments of today, the form of money keeps changing, yet its core role as a medium of exchange and a measure of value has not changed over thousands of years.

pairs.zh: 认识货币的来龙去脉，也就等于拿到了一把理解经济生活的钥匙，懂得它从哪里来、又为什么被大家信任，我们看世界的眼光会清晰许多。
pairs.en: Understanding the full story of money is like holding a key to economic life; knowing where it came from and why it is trusted will sharpen our view of the world.

pairs.zh: 在日常里，理解了货币的本质，我们就能明白为什么攒下的钱要尽量花在能生钱的地方，为什么盯着物价、关注币值稳定并非小事。
pairs.en: In daily life, understanding the essence of money helps us see why what we save should be spent where it can grow, and why watching prices and caring about currency stability is no small matter.

pairs.zh: 它不只是钱包里那几张纸，更是连接千家万户、维系整个社会分工运转的一条看不见的线，这条线顺畅，日子就过得踏实；
pairs.en: It is not just the few notes in the wallet but an invisible thread linking countless households and sustaining the division of labor across society; when the thread runs smoothly, life feels secure;

pairs.zh: 这条线出了问题，再勤奋的劳作也可能打了折扣。
pairs.en: when the thread breaks, even the hardest work may be discounted.

pairs.zh: 现代人的生活几乎离不开银行。
pairs.en: Modern life can hardly do without banks.

pairs.zh: 发了工资要存进银行，买房要向银行贷款，出门购物可以刷卡扫码，这些看似平常的背后，是一整套分工细致、环环相扣的银行体系在运转。
pairs.en: Salaries are deposited in banks, houses are bought with bank loans, and shopping is paid by card or by scanning codes; behind these ordinary routines runs a banking system with fine division of labor and closely interlocking parts.

pairs.zh: 一个国家的银行体系通常分为两个层次：居于顶端的是中央银行，负责制定和执行货币政策，并不直接对普通百姓办理业务；
pairs.en: A country's banking system is usually divided into two tiers: at the top sits the central bank, which formulates and implements monetary policy and does not directly handle business for ordinary people;

pairs.zh: 第二层是众多的商业银行和各类金融机构，直接面对企业和个人，吸收存款、发放贷款，提供日常的金融服务。
pairs.en: the second tier consists of the many commercial banks and various financial institutions that face enterprises and individuals directly, taking deposits, granting loans, and providing everyday financial services.

pairs.zh: 这样的分层设计，既保证了宏观调控的集中统一，又让贴近百姓的服务灵活多样。
pairs.en: This layered design both ensures unified macro control and keeps the services close to people flexible and diverse.

pairs.zh: 中央银行好比整个银行体系的心脏和总管。
pairs.en: The central bank is like the heart and general manager of the entire banking system.

pairs.zh: 它掌管着国家的货币发行，调节市场上流通的货币总量，还要充当商业银行最后贷款人的角色。
pairs.en: It controls the issuance of the country's currency, regulates the total amount of money circulating in the market, and also serves as the lender of last resort for commercial banks.

pairs.zh: 当某家银行临时资金紧张、同业之间又借不到钱时，中央银行可以出面提供资金，防止局部的困难蔓延成系统性的风险。
pairs.en: When a bank is temporarily short of funds and cannot borrow from its peers, the central bank can step in with funding, preventing a local difficulty from spreading into systemic risk.

pairs.zh: 它还负责清算各家银行之间的往来账目，比如甲银行的客户给乙银行的客户转了一笔钱，最终要通过中央银行来轧平。
pairs.en: It is also responsible for settling the accounts between banks: for example, when a customer of Bank A transfers money to a customer of Bank B, the books must ultimately be squared through the central bank.

pairs.zh: 它还监督整个体系的安全运行，检查各家银行的账目是否稳健。
pairs.en: It also supervises the safe operation of the whole system, checking whether the accounts of each bank are sound.

pairs.zh: 可以说，中央银行掌握着松紧货币的总闸门，经济偏冷时它会设法放水，降低利率、给市场注入活力，经济过热、物价上涨过快时它又会收紧，提高利率、收回一部分货币，给经济降降温。
pairs.en: One could say the central bank holds the master valve of monetary easing and tightening: when the economy is cold it finds ways to release water, cutting interest rates and injecting vitality into the market, and when the economy overheats and prices rise too fast it tightens, raising rates and withdrawing part of the money to cool things down.

pairs.zh: 这套张弛之道，深刻影响着我们每个人存钱贷款的成本。
pairs.en: This art of loosen and tighten deeply affects the cost of saving and borrowing for every one of us.

pairs.zh: 除了存贷款，现代银行还提供许多贴近生活的服务。
pairs.en: Besides deposits and loans, modern banks offer many services close to daily life.

pairs.zh: 代收水电费、代发工资、办理汇款、兑换外汇、代销理财与保险，这些不需要银行自己掏本钱的业务，统称为中间业务，却极大地方便了千家万户。
pairs.en: Collecting utility bills, paying salaries on behalf of employers, handling remittances, exchanging foreign currency, and distributing wealth-management products and insurance, these businesses that do not require banks to commit their own capital are collectively called intermediary business, yet they greatly benefit countless households.

pairs.zh: 一个小商贩每天把营业款存进银行，既安全又能生息；
pairs.en: A small vendor deposits each day's takings in the bank, safe and interest-bearing;

pairs.zh: 一对年轻夫妇通过按揭贷款，提前住进了梦寐以求的房子；
pairs.en: a young couple moves into their dream home ahead of schedule through a mortgage;

pairs.zh: 一家小企业靠银行的短期周转贷款，顺利渡过了回款不及的难关。
pairs.en: and a small enterprise, with a short-term working-capital loan from the bank, smoothly survives a period when payments come in late.

pairs.zh: 银行就这样渗透到经济的毛细血管里，把分散的小钱聚沙成塔，再输送到急需用钱的地方。
pairs.en: In this way, banks permeate the capillaries of the economy, gathering scattered small sums into a great pool and channeling them to where money is urgently needed.

pairs.zh: 也正因为银行和千家万户的钱袋子紧密相连，它的一举一动格外受到监管当局的重视，资本是否充足、风控是否严密，都被放在聚光灯下反复检视。
pairs.en: Precisely because banks are so closely tied to the money bags of countless households, every move they make attracts special attention from regulators, and whether capital is sufficient and risk control is strict are repeatedly examined under the spotlight.

pairs.zh: 把这套体系放到生活里观察，就会发现它其实并不遥远。
pairs.en: Observing this system in daily life, one finds it is not actually far away.

pairs.zh: 清晨路边的早餐摊，用收款码收来的钱，背后连着银行的清算网络；
pairs.en: The breakfast stall on the street in the morning, with money collected through payment codes, is connected behind the scenes to the banks' clearing network;

pairs.zh: 一对新人办理房贷，利率的高低牵动着他们今后十几年的生活；
pairs.en: a newlywed couple taking out a home loan finds the interest rate shaping their lives for the next dozen or more years;

pairs.zh: 一家工厂申请贷款扩大产能，决定了它能不能拿下新订单。
pairs.en: and a factory applying for a loan to expand capacity determines whether it can win new orders.

pairs.zh: 银行体系一边把社会上暂时不用的钱聚拢起来，一边把这些钱送到最能创造价值的地方，使储蓄转化为投资，让今天的余裕变成明天的产出。
pairs.en: The banking system, on the one hand, gathers the money society does not need at the moment, and on the other, sends it to where it can create the most value, turning savings into investment and today's surplus into tomorrow's output.

pairs.zh: 可以说，一个运转良好的银行体系，是经济得以血脉畅通的前提，它既为普通人的点滴财富提供了安全的家，也为整个社会的建设和创新源源不断地注入着资金活水。
pairs.en: One could say a well-functioning banking system is the precondition for an economy with unobstructed circulation of blood: it provides a safe home for the modest wealth of ordinary people and continuously injects fresh capital into society's construction and innovation.

pairs.zh: 商业银行则是我们最常接触的一类。
pairs.en: Commercial banks are the type we come into contact with most often.

pairs.zh: 它们从老百姓手里吸收闲散存款，再把这些钱集中起来贷给需要资金的企业和个人，赚取存贷款之间的利息差额。
pairs.en: They absorb idle deposits from the people, pool these funds, and lend them to enterprises and individuals in need, earning the interest spread between deposits and loans.

pairs.zh: 企业要扩大生产、上新项目，往往需要大笔资金，单凭自有积累很难一步到位，银行贷款就成了重要的来源。
pairs.en: Enterprises that want to expand production and launch new projects often need large amounts of capital; their own accumulated savings alone can rarely cover it at once, and bank loans become an important source.

pairs.zh: 个人买房、买车、装修、上学，也常常借助贷款来平滑开支，先住上新房子、用上好车子，再用今后的收入慢慢偿还。
pairs.en: Individuals buying homes, cars, renovations, and education often borrow as well to smooth their spending, moving into a new house and driving a good car first, then repaying gradually with future income.

pairs.zh: 银行在办理这些业务时，必须谨慎评估借款人的信用和还款能力，看看他的收入稳不稳、有没有其他负债、抵押物足不足，把钱借给能按时归还的人，自身才能稳健经营。
pairs.en: When handling these businesses, banks must carefully assess the borrower's credit and repayment ability, examining whether income is stable, whether there are other debts, and whether collateral is sufficient, so that lending only to those who can repay on time keeps the bank itself operating soundly.

pairs.zh: 为了防范风险，法律要求银行留出一部分准备金，不能把吸收来的存款全部贷出去，万一储户集中取款，手里也得留有余地。
pairs.en: To guard against risk, the law requires banks to set aside a portion of reserves and forbids lending out all the deposits they take in, so that even if depositors line up to withdraw, the bank still has something in hand.

pairs.zh: 现代银行体系还有一套保障储户利益的制度安排。
pairs.en: The modern banking system also has institutional arrangements to protect depositors' interests.

pairs.zh: 许多国家都设立了存款保险，万一银行经营出现问题，储户存在里面的钱在一定额度内仍然有保障，这能稳定人心，避免大家一有风吹草动就一窝蜂地挤兑。
pairs.en: Many countries have established deposit insurance: should a bank run into trouble, depositors' money remains protected up to a certain limit, which steadies people's minds and keeps them from rushing to withdraw all at once at the first sign of trouble.

pairs.zh: 历史上，恐慌性的挤兑曾经拖垮过原本还算健康的银行，因为一旦大家都去取钱，银行短期内是拿不出那么多现钱的。
pairs.en: In history, panic-driven bank runs dragged down banks that were otherwise healthy, because once everyone rushes to withdraw, no bank can produce that much cash in a short time.

pairs.zh: 有了这层保障，储户心里踏实，体系也更稳固。
pairs.en: With this layer of protection, depositors feel secure and the system is more stable.

pairs.zh: 随着技术发展，银行的服务方式也在快速变化，过去要排很久队才能办好的转账、缴费、查余额，如今在手机上点几下就能完成，网点也越开越智能。
pairs.en: As technology develops, the way banks serve people is changing rapidly: transfers, bill payments, and balance checks that once required long queues can now be done with a few taps on the phone, and branches are becoming increasingly intelligent.

pairs.zh: 但无论手段如何更新，银行体系最根本的功能始终没有变，那就是在资金的盈余者和短缺者之间牵线搭桥，让社会上的钱流动到最需要它的地方，从而支撑整个经济的运转与发展，让闲置的财富变成推动生产和建设的力量。
pairs.en: But no matter how the means change, the most fundamental function of the banking system never changes: it links those with surplus funds and those in need, letting society's money flow to where it is most needed, thereby supporting the operation and development of the entire economy and turning idle wealth into a force for production and construction.

pairs.zh: 对普通人来说，多了解一点银行体系的运行规律，明白利率为何上下浮动、存款为何安全有保，也就多了一份打理自己钱袋子的底气。
pairs.en: For ordinary people, learning a little more about how the banking system works, understanding why interest rates fluctuate and why deposits are safe and protected, adds confidence in managing their own wallets.

pairs.zh: 我们不必成为金融专家，却应当知道，把钱存在哪里更稳妥，贷款时要留意哪些条款，让这套庞大而精密的体系，真正为自己的生活服务，而不是被它的术语和数字绕得晕头转向。
pairs.en: We need not become financial experts, but we should know where it is safer to keep money and what clauses to watch when taking a loan, letting this vast and precise system truly serve our lives rather than dizzying us with its jargon and numbers.

pairs.zh: 说到底，银行体系不过是把大家的钱聚拢起来、再合理分配出去的一套精巧安排，理解了它，我们对身边的金融现象就会多一份从容和把握。
pairs.en: In the end, the banking system is nothing more than an ingenious arrangement that pools everyone's money and distributes it sensibly; understanding it gives us more composure and grasp when facing the financial phenomena around us.

pairs.zh: 股票是股份公司发给股东的所有权凭证，持有股票就意味着成为这家公司的主人之一，可以按份额分享公司的经营成果。
pairs.en: A stock is a certificate of ownership issued by a joint-stock company to its shareholders; holding it means becoming one of the owners of the company and sharing in its operating results according to one's share.

pairs.zh: 公司为了扩大经营，常常需要大笔资金，向银行借要付利息，还要到期归还，把一部分股权卖给公众则不必还本，盈利了大家一起分享，亏损了大家共同承担，于是股票便应运而生。
pairs.en: To expand their business, companies often need large amounts of capital; borrowing from banks means paying interest and repaying on schedule, while selling part of the equity to the public requires no repayment, with profits shared by all when business is good and losses borne together when it is bad, and so stocks came into being.

pairs.zh: 股票市场就是这些凭证公开买卖的场所，它一端连接着需要资金的企业，一端连接着手里有闲钱、希望分享成长收益的投资者，二者各取所需，市场由此活跃起来。
pairs.en: The stock market is the venue where these certificates are publicly traded; one end connects companies in need of capital, and the other connects investors with idle money who hope to share in growth returns, and with each side getting what it needs, the market becomes active.

pairs.zh: 企业拿到钱可以上新项目、雇更多工人，投资者则有机会随着企业的壮大而分享收益。
pairs.en: Companies that receive the money can launch new projects and hire more workers, while investors have the opportunity to share returns as the companies grow.

pairs.zh: 进入股票市场，首先要弄清楚价格为什么会上下波动。
pairs.en: Before entering the stock market, one must first understand why prices fluctuate.

pairs.zh: 短期内，股价受消息、情绪、资金供求的影响很大，可能一天之内就大涨大跌，看起来捉摸不定。
pairs.en: In the short term, stock prices are greatly affected by news, sentiment, and the supply and demand of funds, and may swing sharply within a single day, looking unpredictable.

pairs.zh: 一条传闻、一份超预期的业绩、一次行业政策的变化，都可能让投资者争先恐后地买入或卖出。
pairs.en: A rumor, better-than-expected earnings, or a change in industry policy can all make investors rush to buy or sell.

pairs.zh: 但拉长时间看，股价终究要回归公司本身的价值。
pairs.en: But over a longer horizon, stock prices eventually return to the value of the companies themselves.

pairs.zh: 一家公司如果生意越做越好，利润逐年增长，品牌越来越响，它的股票自然更值钱；
pairs.en: If a company does better and better business, with profits growing year after year and its brand growing stronger, its stock naturally becomes more valuable;

pairs.zh: 相反，如果经营每况愈下，产品卖不出去，债务越背越重，再好的故事也撑不住股价。
pairs.en: conversely, if operations deteriorate, products stop selling, and debt keeps piling up, no amount of good storytelling can prop up the stock price.

pairs.zh: 价值投资的思路正是抓住这一点：不去猜测明天的涨跌，而是认真研究企业本身，估算它真正值多少钱，等到市场情绪低落、股价被压低到合理价格之下时买进，然后耐心持有，等待企业成长兑现价值。
pairs.en: The idea of value investing seizes exactly on this: instead of guessing tomorrow's rise or fall, seriously study the business itself, estimate what it is truly worth, buy when market sentiment is low and the price is pushed below a reasonable level, then hold patiently and wait for the business's growth to realize its value.

pairs.zh: 要做到这一点，投资者需要下一番笨功夫。
pairs.en: To achieve this, investors need to put in some painstaking effort.

pairs.zh: 他要读公司的年报，了解它靠什么赚钱，成本高不高，行业地位稳不稳，竞争对手强不强，未来几年有没有增长空间。
pairs.en: They must read the company's annual reports, learn what it relies on to make money, whether costs are high, whether its industry position is stable, how strong competitors are, and whether there is room for growth in the coming years.

pairs.zh: 他要算一算这家公司过去多年赚了多少钱，负债是否过重，把这些家底摸清楚，再结合行业的前景，给出一个自己认为合理的估值。
pairs.en: They must calculate how much the company has earned over many past years and whether debt is too heavy, get a clear picture of its fundamentals, and then, together with the industry's prospects, arrive at a valuation they consider reasonable.

pairs.zh: 他还要留出安全边际，也就是用明显低于估算价值的价格买入，这样即使自己判断有偏差，市场继续下跌，也不至于吃太大的亏。
pairs.en: They must also leave a margin of safety, that is, buy at a price clearly below the estimated value, so that even if their judgment is off and the market keeps falling, they will not suffer too badly.

pairs.zh: 价值投资并不追求一夜暴富，它信奉的是长期和理性，常说的一句话是，把股票看作企业所有权的一部分，而不是屏幕上跳动的符号。
pairs.en: Value investing does not pursue getting rich overnight; it believes in the long term and in rationality, and its oft-quoted saying is to view stocks as a share of business ownership rather than as symbols jumping on a screen.

pairs.zh: 历史上那些成功的投资者，大多是靠着这种朴素而坚定的理念，在市场的起伏中稳步积累起财富，任凭旁人追涨杀跌，他们始终按自己的节奏行事。
pairs.en: Historically, the successful investors were mostly those who, with such plain and steadfast convictions, steadily built wealth amid market ups and downs; while others chased rises and fled falls, they always acted at their own pace.

pairs.zh: 股市里还有一些基本常识值得初学者知晓。
pairs.en: There are also some basic facts in the stock market worth knowing for beginners.

pairs.zh: 人们常说的大盘涨跌，其实是用一组有代表性的股票价格加权计算出来的指数，它像体温计一样反映着整体市场的冷暖。
pairs.en: The rise and fall of the broader market, as people often say, is actually an index calculated by weighting the prices of a group of representative stocks; it reflects the warmth or coldness of the overall market like a thermometer.

pairs.zh: 市场上的股票成千上万，分属不同的行业，有的与百姓吃喝住行紧密相关，有的专门服务于科技进步，景气周期各不相同。
pairs.en: There are thousands upon thousands of stocks in the market, belonging to different industries; some are closely tied to people's food, clothing, housing, and travel, while others serve technological progress, and their business cycles differ.

pairs.zh: 新手最容易犯的错误，是看到哪只股票涨得凶就一窝蜂地追进去，又听到一点风吹草动就慌忙卖出，结果往往是高买低卖。
pairs.en: The most common mistake beginners make is to chase after whichever stock is rising hard, then sell in a panic at the first hint of trouble, often ending up buying high and selling low.

pairs.zh: 价值投资提醒我们，与其预测短期的风向，不如把功夫花在理解生意上，挑选那些自己看得懂、经营稳健、价格合理的公司，然后给它足够的时间。
pairs.en: Value investing reminds us that rather than predicting short-term winds, it is better to put effort into understanding the business, choosing companies that we can understand, that operate steadily, and are reasonably priced, and then give them enough time.

pairs.zh: 复利的力量在于长久，一年稳稳地增长一成，二三十年下来，财富的积累会远远超出直觉，而这恰恰需要坐得住冷板凳的耐心。
pairs.en: The power of compound interest lies in the long run: growing steadily at ten percent a year, over twenty or thirty years wealth accumulation far exceeds intuition, and this is precisely what requires the patience to sit on a cold bench.

pairs.zh: 对于刚入门的人来说，与其一上来就追逐热门个股，不如先用一小笔钱熟悉市场的脾气，体会一下账户起伏带来的情绪波动，再决定自己适合走哪条路。
pairs.en: For beginners, rather than chasing hot individual stocks right away, it is better to first use a small sum of money to learn the market's temperament, experience the emotional swings that account fluctuations bring, and then decide which path suits them.

pairs.zh: 有人喜欢亲自研究公司、挑选股票，享受参与其中的乐趣；
pairs.en: Some enjoy researching companies and picking stocks themselves, savoring the fun of participation;

pairs.zh: 更多人则发现，与其自己费心挑选，不如长期买入那些跟踪大盘指数的品种，稳稳拿到市场的平均回报，既省心力又避开了选股的巨大不确定性。
pairs.en: more people, however, find that instead of painstakingly picking, it is better to buy long-term products that track the broad index, steadily earning the market's average return, saving effort and avoiding the enormous uncertainty of stock selection.

pairs.zh: 无论选择哪条路，有一点是共同的，那就是用闲钱、放长线、戒贪婪、惧恐慌。
pairs.en: Whichever path one chooses, one thing is common: use spare money, invest for the long term, curb greed, and fear panic.

pairs.zh: 股市从来不是比谁赚得快，而是比谁活得久、走得稳，那些在风暴中依然守住原则的人，往往才能笑到最后。
pairs.en: The stock market has never been about who makes money fastest, but about who lives longest and walks most steadily; those who still hold to their principles in the storm are often the ones who laugh last.

pairs.zh: 当然，股市也有它残酷的一面。
pairs.en: Of course, the stock market also has its cruel side.

pairs.zh: 价格短期由人心决定，过度贪婪会让人在高位追涨，觉得还能再涨；
pairs.en: Prices are decided by human hearts in the short term; excessive greed makes people chase highs, believing prices can rise further;

pairs.zh: 过度恐惧又会让人在底部割肉，担心还要再跌，许多人正是被情绪牵着鼻子走，反复高买低卖，把本金一点点消耗掉。
pairs.en: excessive fear makes people sell at the bottom, worrying that prices will fall more, and many people are led by the nose by their emotions, repeatedly buying high and selling low until their principal is gradually consumed.

pairs.zh: 认识到这一点，价值投资者强调独立思考、控制仓位、不盲目跟风，别人抢购时他多一分冷静，别人抛售时他多一分从容。
pairs.en: Recognizing this, value investors emphasize independent thinking, position control, and not blindly following the crowd: when others are grabbing, they stay a bit calmer, and when others are dumping, they stay a bit more composed.

pairs.zh: 股票市场既可以是普通人分享经济成长的通道，也可以是考验人性的场所。
pairs.en: The stock market can be a channel for ordinary people to share in economic growth, and it can also be a place that tests human nature.

pairs.zh: 懂得敬畏市场、坚持研究、保持耐心，才有可能在这条路上走得长远，而不是被一时的热潮和恐慌所左右。
pairs.en: Only by respecting the market, persisting in research, and staying patient can one walk far on this road, rather than being swayed by temporary fads and panics.

pairs.zh: 说到底，买股票买的是公司的未来，而不是一张期待有人出更高价接走的彩票，想清楚这一层，投资的心态就会沉稳许多。
pairs.en: In the end, buying a stock means buying the company's future, not a lottery ticket hoping someone else will pay a higher price to take it off your hands; once this is clear, the investing mindset becomes much steadier.

pairs.zh: 股市的大门对所有人敞开，但它回报的往往是那些肯下功夫、又耐得住寂寞的人。
pairs.en: The gate of the stock market is open to everyone, but it rewards those who are willing to work hard and can endure loneliness.

pairs.zh: 与其把它当作一夜暴富的赌场，不如把它看作陪优秀企业一起成长的长桌，坐得久了，时间自然会给懂它的人一份宽厚的回报。
pairs.en: Rather than treating it as a casino for overnight riches, it is better to see it as a long table for growing together with excellent companies; sit long enough, and time will naturally give those who understand it a generous reward.

pairs.zh: 这份回报不喧哗，却扎实，它偏爱那些在众人狂热时保持冷静、在众人恐惧时敢于坚持的人。
pairs.en: This reward is not loud but solid; it favors those who stay calm when the crowd is frenzied and dare to persist when the crowd is fearful.

pairs.zh: 看清价值、耐住寂寞，时间终会站在理性这一边。
pairs.en: See value clearly and endure loneliness; in the end, time will stand on the side of rationality.

pairs.zh: 对于大多数普通家庭来说，手里有了一点闲钱，想让它增值，却又不懂怎么挑选股票、研究债券，往往会感到为难。
pairs.en: For most ordinary families, having some spare money and wanting it to grow, yet not knowing how to pick stocks or study bonds, often feels daunting.

pairs.zh: 自己去炒股吧，既没有时间天天盯盘，也缺乏分析财报的本事，一不小心就被套牢。
pairs.en: Trading stocks on your own means neither having time to watch the market every day nor the skill to analyze financial statements, and one misstep leaves you trapped.

pairs.zh: 基金这种工具，正是为解决这个难题而出现的。
pairs.en: The fund, as a tool, came into being precisely to solve this problem.

pairs.zh: 简单说，基金就是把许多人的钱汇集起来，交给专业的投资团队去统一管理和运作，赚了钱按份额分配，亏了也由大家共同承担。
pairs.en: In simple terms, a fund pools the money of many people and hands it to a professional investment team for unified management and operation; profits are distributed by share, and losses are also borne by everyone together.

pairs.zh: 这样一来，哪怕只有很少的本金，普通人也能买到几十上百种资产，分散到不同的行业和公司，不必独自承担把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里的风险。
pairs.en: In this way, even with very little principal, ordinary people can own dozens or hundreds of assets spread across different industries and companies, without bearing alone the risk of putting all eggs in one basket.

pairs.zh: 专家团队则凭借研究和信息，替千家万户做出买卖决策。
pairs.en: The expert team, drawing on research and information, makes buy and sell decisions on behalf of countless households.

pairs.zh: 基金的种类不少，初学者先要弄明白大致的分类，才能选到适合自己的品种。
pairs.en: Funds come in many varieties, and beginners must first understand the rough classification to choose the right one.

pairs.zh: 把主要资金投向股票的叫股票型基金，收益潜力高，但波动也大，涨跌起来比较刺激，遇到行情不好时账面可能缩水不少。
pairs.en: Funds that invest mainly in stocks are called equity funds; their return potential is high, but so is their volatility, with ups and downs that can be dramatic and account values that can shrink considerably in bad markets.

pairs.zh: 主要投向债券的叫债券型基金，走势相对平稳，收益不高却比较踏实，像春雨润物那样慢慢积累。
pairs.en: Funds that invest mainly in bonds are called bond funds; their path is relatively steady, with modest but dependable returns, accumulating slowly like spring rain nourishing things.

pairs.zh: 还有一类同时买股票又买债券，二者按比例搭配，风险和收益介于两者之间，适合不想走极端、希望进可攻退可守的人。
pairs.en: There is also a type that buys both stocks and bonds in a fixed proportion, with risk and return between the two, suitable for those who want neither extremes and prefer to attack or defend as conditions allow.

pairs.zh: 此外，有一种操作更为省心的品种，它完全照着某个指数的成分股去买入，不做主观判断，既不试图跑赢市场，也不刻意挑拣，费用也很低，长期跟随市场整体上涨，深受那些没时间研究、又想分享平均收益的懒人投资者的喜爱。
pairs.en: In addition, there is a more effortless variety that simply buys according to the constituent stocks of a certain index, making no subjective judgments, neither trying to beat the market nor deliberately picking and choosing, with very low fees; following the overall market upward over the long term, it is beloved by lazy investors who have no time to research yet want to share in the average return.

pairs.zh: 买基金的方式也有讲究。
pairs.en: The way of buying funds also has its nuances.

pairs.zh: 有人选择在某个时间一次性买入，押注自己判断的时机，判断对了收获丰厚，判断错了也可能买在高点。
pairs.en: Some people choose to buy all at once at a certain time, betting on their judgment of timing; getting it right brings rich rewards, but getting it wrong may mean buying at a peak.

pairs.zh: 更多普通人则采用定期定额的办法，每个月固定拿出一笔钱投进去，发了工资就划出一小部分。
pairs.en: More ordinary people instead adopt a regular fixed-amount approach, putting a fixed sum in every month, setting aside a small portion as soon as the salary arrives.

pairs.zh: 这种做法的好处是，行情高的时候同样的钱买得份额少，行情低的时候买得份额多，长期下来成本被自动摊平，也避免了因择时而带来的心理压力，不用天天纠结现在到底该不该进场。
pairs.en: The advantage of this practice is that when the market is high, the same money buys fewer units, and when the market is low, it buys more, so over time the cost is automatically averaged, and the psychological pressure of timing is avoided, with no need to agonize daily over whether to enter now.

pairs.zh: 它特别适合收入稳定、没有时间天天盯盘的上班族，只要坚持下去，时间往往会站在耐心者这一边，平滑的成本加上长期的复利，能让一笔笔小钱慢慢聚沙成塔。
pairs.en: It suits office workers with stable income and no time to watch the market daily; as long as they persist, time often stands on the side of the patient, and smooth costs plus long-term compounding let small sums gradually accumulate into a tower.

pairs.zh: 买基金时，还有几个小知识应当心里有数。
pairs.en: When buying funds, there are also a few small points worth knowing.

pairs.zh: 基金的价格叫作净值，每天收市后计算一次，代表每一份额当前值多少钱。
pairs.en: The price of a fund is called its net asset value, calculated once after the market closes each day, representing how much each unit is currently worth.

pairs.zh: 买入和赎回都要按规则支付一定费用，频繁操作的人，手续费日积月累下来也是一笔不小的数目，所以越是短期频繁进出，越容易被费用侵蚀收益。
pairs.en: Both buying and redeeming incur certain fees according to the rules, and for frequent traders, fees accumulating day by day amount to a considerable sum, so the more frequent the short-term in-and-out, the more returns are eroded by fees.

pairs.zh: 挑选基金时，与其只看谁过去一年涨得最猛，不如多考察它经历过几轮涨跌、长期业绩是否稳定、基金经理是否稳定，以及它持有的资产是否与自己的脾气相投。
pairs.en: When choosing a fund, rather than looking only at who rose most sharply in the past year, it is better to examine how it fared through several rounds of ups and downs, whether long-term performance is stable, whether the fund manager is stable, and whether the assets it holds match one's own temperament.

pairs.zh: 有人图省心，干脆把钱分成几份，分别投进风格不同的几只基金，让它们彼此搭配，东方不亮西方亮。
pairs.en: Some people, seeking convenience, simply split their money into several parts and invest in several funds of different styles, letting them complement each other, so that when the east is dark the west is bright.

pairs.zh: 这种分散配置的思路，和不把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里是同一个道理。
pairs.en: This idea of diversified allocation is the same as not putting all eggs in one basket.

pairs.zh: 还要提醒新手避开几个常见的陷阱。
pairs.en: Beginners should also be reminded to avoid several common traps.

pairs.zh: 其一是只盯着短期排行榜，谁最近涨得好就买谁，可排名年年换，等追进去时往往正好接在高点。
pairs.en: The first is staring only at short-term rankings, buying whichever rose most recently, yet rankings change every year, and by the time one chases in, it often happens to be right at the peak.

pairs.zh: 其二是一看到下跌就慌忙赎回，把浮亏变成实实在在的损失，却忘了市场有涨有跌本是常态。
pairs.en: The second is redeeming in a panic at the first sign of a decline, turning paper losses into real losses, while forgetting that markets rising and falling is the norm.

pairs.zh: 其三是把本应长期投的钱，拿去做频繁的短线进出，结果收益没见多少，手续费倒是交了不少。
pairs.en: The third is taking money meant for long-term investment and making frequent short-term in-and-out trades, ending up with little return but plenty of fees paid.

pairs.zh: 真正在这条路上受益的人，大多是那些设定好目标、选好品种、然后默默坚持的人，他们不被一时的涨跌牵着情绪走，而是把眼光放在三年五年之后。
pairs.en: Those who truly benefit on this road are mostly people who set goals, choose their products, and then persist quietly; they are not led by emotion through temporary rises and falls but keep their eyes on three to five years ahead.

pairs.zh: 基金投资说到底是一场耐心的长跑，比的不是谁冲得猛，而是谁能稳稳地跑完全程。
pairs.en: Fund investing, in the final analysis, is a patient long race; it is not about who charges hardest but about who can steadily complete the whole course.

pairs.zh: 入门阶段还要牢记几条朴素的原则。
pairs.en: At the entry stage, a few plain principles must also be kept in mind.

pairs.zh: 一是量力而行，只用三五年内用不到的闲钱去投资，不要把吃饭看病、孩子上学的钱都投进去，否则一旦急需用钱，很可能被迫在低点卖出。
pairs.en: First, invest within your means, using only spare money you will not need for three to five years, and never put in money meant for meals, medical care, or children's education, or you may be forced to sell at a low point in an emergency.

pairs.zh: 二是放长期眼光，频繁地追涨杀跌、今天申购明天赎回，往往是在给手续费打工，看着热闹却没赚到钱。
pairs.en: Second, take a long-term view; frequently chasing rises and fleeing falls, subscribing today and redeeming tomorrow, often means working for the fees, looking lively but earning nothing.

pairs.zh: 三是认清自己的风险承受能力，性子急、见不得账面亏损的人，就别硬逼着自己去碰波动很大的品种，晚上睡不着觉的投资方式并不适合。
pairs.en: Third, know your own risk tolerance; those with impatient temperaments who cannot bear paper losses should not force themselves into highly volatile products, and an investment that keeps you up at night does not suit you.

pairs.zh: 基金并不是稳赚不赔的神话，它同样有起有落，遇到熊市也会让人难受，但相比独自炒股，它把专业的事交给了专业的人，又用分散降低了风险，对大多数普通家庭而言，是一条较为温和、可持续的财富积累之路，假以时日，往往能看到令人安心的结果。
pairs.en: Funds are not a myth of guaranteed profit without loss; they too rise and fall and can be painful in bear markets, but compared with stock trading on one's own, they leave the professional matters to professionals and reduce risk through diversification; for most ordinary families they are a gentler and sustainable path to wealth accumulation that, given time, often yields reassuring results.

pairs.zh: 对刚刚起步的家庭而言，不妨从每月一小笔钱的定投开始，先熟悉净值的起伏，再逐步增加投入的比例。
pairs.en: For families just starting out, it is advisable to begin with a small monthly fixed investment, first getting familiar with the fluctuations of net asset value, then gradually increasing the proportion invested.

pairs.zh: 不必羡慕别人短期的暴利，也不必为一时的回撤而惊慌，理财是陪伴一生的功课，把基础打牢、把心态放平，时间这位老友自会给出公道的答案。
pairs.en: Do not envy others' short-term windfalls, nor panic at temporary drawdowns; wealth management is a lesson for a lifetime, and if you build a solid foundation and keep a level mindset, time, that old friend, will naturally give a fair answer.

pairs.zh: 等再过几年回头看，那些曾经让自己辗转反侧的起伏，往往早已化作账户里稳稳向上的曲线，而当初坚持下来的那份从容，正是最可贵的收获。
pairs.en: Looking back a few years later, the ups and downs that once kept you tossing and turning have often already become a steadily rising curve in your account, and the composure you held through it all is the most precious gain.

pairs.zh: 入门不必求快，先把规则弄懂，把风险看清，再让钱慢慢替自己工作，这条路虽然平缓，却走得长远。
pairs.en: At the entry stage, do not seek speed; first understand the rules, see the risks clearly, and then let money slowly work for you; this road is gentle, but it goes far.

pairs.zh: 如果说股票代表着对企业的所有权，那么债券代表的就是一张借条。
pairs.en: If stocks represent ownership of a company, then bonds represent an IOU.

pairs.zh: 国家要修路架桥、城市要建设公共设施、企业要扩建厂房，常常需要向社会借钱，它们开出的这种书面借据就是债券。
pairs.en: When a country needs to build roads and bridges, a city needs public facilities, or an enterprise needs to expand its plant, they often borrow from society, and the written instruments they issue are bonds.

pairs.zh: 持有的人把钱借出去，等于把自己暂时不用的闲钱交给急需用钱的一方去使用；
pairs.en: Holders lend out their money, in effect handing the idle funds they do not need at the moment to the party that urgently needs them;

pairs.zh: 作为约定，借钱的一方要在约定的期限内，按事先讲好的利率定期支付利息，到期再把本金如数归还。
pairs.en: as agreed, the borrowing party pays interest periodically at a pre-arranged rate within the agreed term and repays the principal in full at maturity.

pairs.zh: 因为未来能拿到多少利息通常是事先确定的，本金能不能收回也写得明明白白，所以这类投资被归入固定收益的范畴，成了许多人资产组合里求稳的那一部分。
pairs.en: Because how much interest will be received in the future is usually determined in advance, and whether the principal can be recovered is written out clearly, this kind of investment falls under the category of fixed income, becoming the steady part of many people's asset portfolios.

pairs.zh: 比起股价的大起大落，债券给人一种踏实的预期。
pairs.en: Compared with the violent swings of stock prices, bonds give people a solid expectation.

pairs.zh: 债券按照发行方的不同，可以分成几大类。
pairs.en: Bonds can be divided into several major categories according to the issuer.

pairs.zh: 由国家发行的叫国债，背后是国家信用，被公认为风险最低的品种，只要国家不出现大的变故，还本付息几乎没有悬念，正因如此，它的利息也相对低一些。
pairs.en: Those issued by the state are called government bonds, backed by national credit and widely recognized as the lowest-risk variety; as long as the country does not undergo major upheaval, the repayment of principal and interest is almost beyond doubt, which is precisely why their interest is relatively lower.

pairs.zh: 地方政府为建设项目筹资发行的债券，安全性通常也比较高，因为背后有地方的税收作支撑。
pairs.en: Bonds issued by local governments to raise funds for construction projects are also usually quite safe, because they are backed by local tax revenue.

pairs.zh: 企业发行的叫公司债，借钱是为了经营和扩张，由于各家企业的经营状况差异很大，不同公司的还债能力差别也很大，因此它们给出的利息高低不一。
pairs.en: Bonds issued by enterprises are called corporate bonds; borrowing is for operations and expansion, and since the operating conditions of different companies vary greatly, their debt-repayment abilities also differ greatly, so the interest they offer varies.

pairs.zh: 信用好的大企业，借钱容易，投资者抢着买，利息可以低一些；
pairs.en: Large enterprises with good credit find it easy to borrow, with investors scrambling to buy, so their interest can be lower;

pairs.zh: 财务状况欠佳的公司，为了吸引资金，往往不得不开出更高的利息，以此补偿投资者承担的额外风险。
pairs.en: companies with poor financial conditions, in order to attract funds, often have no choice but to offer higher interest, compensating investors for the extra risk they bear.

pairs.zh: 这种高息固然诱人，却也意味着更高的违约可能，天下没有白占的便宜。
pairs.en: Such high interest is indeed tempting, but it also means a higher possibility of default; there is no such thing as a free lunch.

pairs.zh: 按还钱期限的长短，债券还可以分成短期、中期和长期几类。
pairs.en: By the length of the repayment term, bonds can also be divided into short-term, medium-term, and long-term categories.

pairs.zh: 短期债券几个月、一年就到期，流动性好，收益偏低；
pairs.en: Short-term bonds mature in a few months or a year, with good liquidity and low returns;

pairs.zh: 长期债券要等上十年甚至更久才能拿回本金，期间要承受的不确定性更多，因此通常给出更高的利息。
pairs.en: long-term bonds take ten years or even longer before the principal comes back, and the uncertainty borne along the way is greater, so they usually offer higher interest.

pairs.zh: 这里要弄清一个常见的道理，债券上写着的票面利率是固定的，可它在市场上买卖的价格却会随行就市，二者此消彼长。
pairs.en: One common point to clarify here is that the coupon rate written on a bond is fixed, yet the price at which it trades in the market moves with supply and demand, and the two offset each other.

pairs.zh: 普通人参与这个市场的渠道也不少，既可以直接认购国家面向个人发行的储蓄债券，也可以通过专门的账户买卖上市交易的债券，或者干脆把钱交给债券型基金，由专业的人去打理一篮子债券，省去自己挑选的麻烦。
pairs.en: Ordinary people have no shortage of channels to participate in this market: they can directly subscribe to savings bonds the state issues to individuals, buy listed bonds through special accounts, or simply hand their money to bond funds and let professionals manage a basket of bonds, saving themselves the trouble of picking.

pairs.zh: 在一个家庭的整体资产安排里，债券常常扮演着压舱石的角色。
pairs.en: In a family's overall asset arrangement, bonds often play the role of ballast.

pairs.zh: 年纪轻、距离用钱还远的人，可以把较大的比例放在成长潜力更高的股票类资产上，用时间去承受波动；
pairs.en: Young people, still far from needing the money, can place a larger proportion in equity-type assets with higher growth potential, using time to bear the volatility;

pairs.zh: 而临近退休、不久就要靠这笔钱生活的人，则应当逐年增加债券这类稳健资产的比重，让账目的起伏平缓下来。
pairs.en: while those approaching retirement, soon to live on this money, should increase year by year the weight of stable assets such as bonds to smooth the ups and downs of their accounts.

pairs.zh: 这种根据年龄和目标不断调整股债比例的做法，体现的正是稳健理财的智慧。
pairs.en: This practice of continuously adjusting the stock-bond ratio according to age and goals embodies exactly the wisdom of prudent wealth management.

pairs.zh: 说到底，买债券并不是为了一夜暴富，而是为了在追逐成长的同时，给财富留出一块安稳的地方，让整个组合进可攻、退可守。
pairs.en: In the end, buying bonds is not about getting rich overnight but about setting aside a stable place for wealth while pursuing growth, so that the whole portfolio can attack and defend.

pairs.zh: 对投资者而言，债券最吸引人的地方在于收益相对可预期、波动相对温和。
pairs.en: For investors, the most attractive thing about bonds is that returns are relatively predictable and volatility relatively mild.

pairs.zh: 把一部分钱配置在债券上，可以平衡整体资产的起落，让组合不至于因为股票市场的剧烈震荡而大起大落。
pairs.en: Allocating part of the money to bonds balances the rise and fall of the overall portfolio, keeping it from swinging wildly because of violent stock-market turbulence.

pairs.zh: 临近退休、追求安稳的人，尤其看重这种能提供稳定现金流的工具，拿着定期到手的利息，心里踏实，日子也安排得从容。
pairs.en: People nearing retirement who seek stability value this kind of tool that provides steady cash flow; with interest arriving regularly in hand, they feel secure and arrange their lives with ease.

pairs.zh: 不过债券也并非完全没有风险，这一点必须讲清楚。
pairs.en: However, bonds are not completely risk-free, and this point must be made clear.

pairs.zh: 市场利率上升时，已经发行的、利息较低的旧债券价格会下跌，因为新发行的债券能给出更高的回报，谁还愿意折价持有旧的呢；
pairs.en: When market interest rates rise, the prices of already-issued old bonds with lower interest fall, because newly issued bonds offer higher returns, and who would want to hold old ones at a discount;

pairs.zh: 反过来，利率下降时，旧债券的价格又会上涨。
pairs.en: conversely, when interest rates fall, the prices of old bonds rise.

pairs.zh: 若借钱的一方经营不善、现金流断裂，还可能出现到期还不上钱的违约情况，严重时连本金都会遭受损失。
pairs.en: If the borrowing party operates poorly and its cash flow breaks, there may even be a default where the money is not repaid at maturity, and in severe cases even the principal suffers loss.

pairs.zh: 在现代金融体系中，固定收益市场的规模往往非常庞大，它不仅是普通投资者理财的选择场所，更是政府融资、企业周转资金的重要渠道。
pairs.en: In the modern financial system, the fixed-income market is often enormous in scale; it is not only a venue for ordinary investors to manage money but also an important channel for government financing and enterprise working-capital turnover.

pairs.zh: 中央银行调节经济时，也常常在这个市场上买卖债券，需要向市场投放资金时就买入债券，需要收回资金时就卖出，以此影响市场上的资金多少和利率高低。
pairs.en: When the central bank adjusts the economy, it also buys and sells bonds in this market: buying bonds to inject funds into the market and selling them to withdraw funds, thereby influencing the amount of money and the level of interest rates.

pairs.zh: 可以说，债券市场是整个金融体系的血脉之一，连接着财政、企业和千家万户。
pairs.en: One could say the bond market is one of the blood vessels of the entire financial system, connecting public finance, enterprises, and countless households.

pairs.zh: 理解债券，就等于理解了整个社会如何借贷、如何为长期建设筹措资金。
pairs.en: Understanding bonds means understanding how the whole society borrows and raises funds for long-term construction.

pairs.zh: 对于希望稳健理财的人来说，弄清国债与公司债之间的差别，弄清利息与价格此消彼长的关系，再根据自己的年龄、用钱计划和风险承受能力合理配置，就能让这份求稳的资产真正发挥压舱石的作用，在风浪来临的时候，为整个家庭的财富守住一份底气。
pairs.en: For those who want prudent wealth management, clarifying the difference between government and corporate bonds, clarifying the offsetting relationship between interest and price, and then allocating sensibly according to age, spending plans, and risk tolerance, will let this stability-seeking asset truly play its ballast role and hold a bottom line of confidence for the family's wealth when the storm comes.

pairs.zh: 固定收益市场看似不如股市热闹，却是整个金融体系里最沉得住气的那一块，懂得在进取之外留出这一份安稳，人生的财务安排才算得上周全而从容。
pairs.en: The fixed-income market may seem less lively than the stock market, but it is the steadiest block in the entire financial system; knowing how to keep this share of stability alongside ambition makes one's financial arrangements complete and composed.

pairs.zh: 无论是为养老做准备，还是为孩子的将来未雨绸缪，这份能提供稳定利息、到期如约还本的资产，都值得每一个追求踏实生活的家庭认真了解、妥善利用。
pairs.en: Whether preparing for retirement or making provisions for children's future, this asset that provides stable interest and repays principal as promised at maturity deserves careful understanding and proper use by every family that pursues a solid life.

pairs.zh: 当我们把债券的脾气摸清楚，让它和股票、存款各就各位，整个家庭的财务大船，就能在风浪里保持平稳，稳稳地驶向多年之后的长远目标，内心也更加踏实。
pairs.en: Once we understand the temperament of bonds and let them, together with stocks and deposits, each take their proper place, the family's financial ship can stay steady in the storm and sail steadily toward long-term goals years ahead, with greater peace of mind.

pairs.zh: 在日常生活中，人们总会遇到各种各样难以预料的意外，一场突如其来的重病，一次交通事故，或是一场大火烧毁了多年积攒下来的家产，这些事情一旦发生，往往会让一个普通家庭陷入长期的困境。
pairs.en: In daily life, people always encounter all kinds of unforeseen accidents: a sudden serious illness, a traffic accident, or a fire that destroys property saved over many years; once these things happen, they often plunge an ordinary family into long-term hardship.

pairs.zh: 正是为了应对这类不确定的损失，保险这种制度才逐渐发展起来。
pairs.en: It is precisely to cope with such uncertain losses that the institution of insurance gradually developed.

pairs.zh: 它的基本道理并不复杂，就是把许多面临相似风险的人聚集在一起，每个人拿出一小笔钱汇成一笔共同的基金，谁不幸遭受了损失，就从这笔基金里拿出钱来帮助他渡过难关，这样一来，原本由一个人独自承担的巨大负担，就被分散到了成千上万的人身上，每个人的压力都变得很小。
pairs.en: Its basic logic is not complicated: gather together many people facing similar risks, have each contribute a small sum into a common fund, and when someone suffers a loss, draw from this fund to help them through the difficulty; in this way, a huge burden that would once have fallen on one person alone is spread across tens of thousands of people, and the pressure on each is very small.

pairs.zh: 古时候人们在邻里之间互相帮衬，谁家建房大家出力，谁家受灾大家捐粮，其实就是这种互助思想的雏形，现代保险公司不过是把这件事做得更专业、更规范、更有计算依据罢了。
pairs.en: In ancient times, people helped each other among neighbors, contributing labor when someone built a house and grain when someone was hit by disaster; this was in fact the prototype of mutual aid, and the modern insurance company merely does the same thing in a more professional, more regulated, and better-calculated way.

pairs.zh: 要理解保险，先要理解风险。
pairs.en: To understand insurance, one must first understand risk.

pairs.zh: 风险并不是指危险本身，而是指损失发生的不确定性，它有大有小，有的发生概率很低但一旦发生后果极其严重，比如重大疾病和早年身故，有的发生概率较高但每次损失都不大，比如小磕小碰和轻微感冒。
pairs.en: Risk does not mean danger itself but the uncertainty of loss; it comes in sizes, some with very low probability but extremely severe consequences when they occur, such as major illness and early death, and others with higher probability but small losses each time, such as minor bumps and mild colds.

pairs.zh: 一个成熟的人做风险管理时，通常会先把面临的风险一一列出来，再分别决定用什么办法去应对。
pairs.en: A mature person doing risk management usually first lists the risks faced one by one, then decides separately what method to use for each.

pairs.zh: 有些风险可以主动避开，比如不闯红灯就能减少出车祸的可能，这叫风险回避。
pairs.en: Some risks can be actively avoided, such as reducing the chance of traffic accidents by not running red lights; this is called risk avoidance.

pairs.zh: 有些风险可以提前预防，比如安装烟雾报警器就能降低火灾造成的损失，开车时系好安全带就能减轻事故的伤害，这叫风险控制。
pairs.en: Some risks can be prevented in advance, such as installing smoke alarms to reduce fire damage and wearing seat belts while driving to lessen the harm of accidents; this is called risk control.

pairs.zh: 还有些风险可以自己承担，比如丢一把雨伞，大多数人不至于因此改变生活，这叫风险自留。
pairs.en: Some risks can be borne by oneself, such as losing an umbrella, which would not change most people's lives; this is called risk retention.

pairs.zh: 而那些一旦发生就足以拖垮全家的大风险，最适合用保险把它转移出去，让专业的机构来分担。
pairs.en: And those big risks that, once they occur, are enough to drag down the whole family are best transferred out through insurance, letting professional institutions share them.

pairs.zh: 判断该不该保，关键就看这件事一旦发生，自己能不能扛得住，扛得住的不必花冤枉钱，扛不住的才是真正需要保险的地方。
pairs.en: The key to deciding whether to insure is whether you can withstand the event if it happens; what you can withstand needs no wasted money, and what you cannot withstand is exactly where insurance is needed.

pairs.zh: 常见的人身保险有这样几类。
pairs.en: Common personal insurance comes in several types.

pairs.zh: 人寿保险以人的生命为保障对象，家里的主要经济支柱如果过早离开，保险公司会赔付一笔钱，让老人有人赡养、孩子有人抚养，房贷也不至于压垮剩下的家人。
pairs.en: Life insurance protects a person's life; if the main breadwinner of the family dies prematurely, the insurance company pays a sum so that the elderly have someone to support them, the children have someone to raise them, and the mortgage does not crush the remaining family.

pairs.zh: 健康保险和医疗保险则针对生病住院的开支，一场大病往往要花费几十万，普通家庭很难一次拿得出，有了基本医保和商业保险的补充，出院时自己需要掏的钱就少了很多。
pairs.en: Health insurance and medical insurance target the expenses of illness and hospitalization; a major illness often costs hundreds of thousands, which an ordinary family can hardly produce at once, and with basic medical insurance supplemented by commercial insurance, what you need to pay out of pocket at discharge is much less.

pairs.zh: 意外伤害保险保费便宜、保障高，专门覆盖意外造成的伤残和身故，年轻人独自在外打拼时尤其值得考虑。
pairs.en: Accident insurance has cheap premiums and high protection, covering specifically the disability and death caused by accidents, and is especially worth considering for young people working alone away from home.

pairs.zh: 除了保人的，还有保财产的，比如车险保的是车辆碰撞和第三方损失，家庭财产保险保的是房屋里的装修和家具，一些责任保险则保的是不小心给别人造成损失后需要赔偿的部分，比如家里的狗咬伤了邻居，或是装修时弄坏了公共管道。
pairs.en: Besides policies on people, there are also policies on property, such as auto insurance covering vehicle collisions and third-party losses, home insurance covering the renovation and furniture in a house, and some liability insurance covering the compensation owed after carelessly harming others, such as a dog biting a neighbor or damaging a public pipe during renovation.

pairs.zh: 买保险并不是越多越好，也不是越贵越好。
pairs.en: Buying insurance is not about buying more or more expensive.

pairs.zh: 普通人安排保障时，通常先把社保这个基础打底，再根据家庭的收入和负债情况考虑商业保险。
pairs.en: When arranging protection, ordinary people usually start with social security as the foundation, then consider commercial insurance according to the family's income and debt.

pairs.zh: 一个比较实用的顺序是，先给挣钱最多的人买足保障，因为他一旦倒下，全家的收入都会受影响，然后再考虑孩子和老人。
pairs.en: A fairly practical order is to first give adequate protection to the highest earner, because if he or she falls, the whole family's income will be affected, and then consider children and the elderly.

pairs.zh: 保额要算得尽量实在，比如定期寿险的保额，往往要覆盖未来十几二十年的家庭开支、孩子教育和剩余的贷款。
pairs.en: The insured amount should be calculated as realistically as possible; for example, the sum insured of term life insurance often needs to cover family expenses for the next ten or twenty years, children's education, and the remaining loan.

pairs.zh: 交费期限可以尽量拉长，这样每年的压力小，万一以后收入变化也不至于交不起而中断。
pairs.en: The payment period can be stretched as long as possible, so that the annual pressure is small, and even if income changes later, one will not be unable to pay and lapse the policy.

pairs.zh: 买的时候还要仔细看清楚条款，哪些情况保、哪些情况不保、等待期有多久、如实告知的要求是什么，这些细节比单纯比价格更重要。
pairs.en: When buying, read the terms carefully: which situations are covered, which are not, how long the waiting period is, and what the requirements for truthful disclosure are; these details matter more than simply comparing prices.

pairs.zh: 投保时隐瞒既往病史，看似占了便宜，真到理赔时却可能被拒赔，反而竹篮打水一场空。
pairs.en: Concealing past medical history when applying may seem like a bargain, but when it comes to claims, the insurer may refuse to pay, and you end up with nothing.

pairs.zh: 在挑选具体的产品时，许多人容易陷入几个误区。
pairs.en: When choosing specific products, many people fall into several misconceptions.

pairs.zh: 有人只看返还，觉得到期能把钱拿回来才划算，却没算过几十年下来利息损失了多少；
pairs.en: Some look only at returns, thinking it is a good deal only if the money comes back at maturity, without calculating how much interest is lost over decades;

pairs.zh: 有人迷信大公司广告打得响，却忽略了条款里的保障范围其实差别很大；
pairs.en: some are swayed by big companies' loud advertising while ignoring that the coverage in the terms actually differs greatly;

pairs.zh: 还有人听信熟人推荐，自己从不翻合同，等到要用才发现保的并不是自己以为的那种病。
pairs.en: and some trust recommendations from acquaintances and never read the contract themselves, only to find when they need it that what is covered is not the illness they thought.

pairs.zh: 比较稳妥的做法，是先想清楚自己最担心什么风险，再去找专门对付这种风险的消费型产品，保费便宜、保障纯粹，把省下的钱用在提高保额上。
pairs.en: A more prudent approach is to first think clearly about which risk worries you most, then look for a consumption-type product that targets exactly that risk, with cheap premiums and pure protection, and use the money saved to raise the insured amount.

pairs.zh: 理赔的时候也不必慌张，按照要求准备好病历、发票和诊断证明，第一时间报案，流程在规范的机构里通常都比较顺畅。
pairs.en: When claiming, there is no need to panic: prepare the medical records, invoices, and diagnosis certificates as required, report promptly, and the process is usually smooth at well-regulated institutions.

pairs.zh: 需要记住的是，保险买的是一份合同上的承诺，白纸黑字写清楚的才作数，业务员口头说得再动听，也不如条款里那几行字可靠。
pairs.en: What must be remembered is that insurance buys a promise written in a contract; only what is written in black and white counts, and no matter how persuasive an agent's words are, they are not as reliable as the few lines in the terms.

pairs.zh: 此外，保单买好之后并不是一劳永逸，每隔几年应当重新检视一次，看看随着家庭收入变化、孩子长大、贷款减少，原来的保额是不是还合适，有没有该加保的地方，也有没有其实可以停掉、白白交着钱的险种。
pairs.en: Moreover, a policy is not a one-time thing after purchase; it should be reviewed every few years to see whether, as income changes, children grow up, and loans decrease, the original insured amount is still appropriate, whether there is coverage to add, and whether there are policies that could be stopped for which money is being paid for nothing.

pairs.zh: 说到底，保险是一种未雨绸缪的安排，它不能阻止意外发生，却能在意外到来时给人一份底气。
pairs.en: In the end, insurance is an arrangement made before trouble comes; it cannot prevent accidents, but it can give people confidence when accidents arrive.

pairs.zh: 学会用正确的方式认识风险、管理风险，把真正沉重的那一部分交给保险，而把能够自己把握的那一部分好好经营，一个家庭的财务才会更稳当，生活也才能走得更远。
pairs.en: Learning to recognize and manage risk the right way, handing the truly heavy part to insurance and managing well the part one can grasp, makes a family's finances steadier and life able to go farther.

title: 量化交易与程序化投资

pairs.zh: 在过去很长一段时间里，人们买卖股票主要依靠经验和判断，看看新闻、听听消息，再凭着感觉决定什么时候买、什么时候卖。
pairs.en: For a very long time in the past, people bought and sold stocks mainly by relying on experience and judgment, reading the news, listening to tips, and then deciding by feel when to buy and when to sell.

pairs.zh: 随着计算机技术的发展，一种全新的做法慢慢流行起来，那就是把投资的思路写成明确的规则，让电脑按照这些规则自动去分析数据、发出指令，这就是量化交易，也叫程序化投资。
pairs.en: As computer technology developed, a brand-new practice slowly became popular: writing the ideas of investing into explicit rules and letting computers automatically analyze data and issue orders according to those rules; this is quantitative trading, also called programmatic investing.

pairs.zh: 它和传统做法最大的不同，在于决策不再依赖一时的情绪和直觉，而是建立在大量历史数据和一套事先想清楚的逻辑之上。
pairs.en: Its biggest difference from traditional practice is that decisions no longer depend on fleeting emotions and intuition but are built on large amounts of historical data and a logic thought through in advance.

pairs.zh: 过去一位老股民要翻遍厚厚的报纸才能勉强看全几家公司的行情，如今一台电脑几秒钟就能把上千只股票的各项指标算得清清楚楚，这种效率上的飞跃，正是量化能够兴起的土壤。
pairs.en: In the past, an old stock trader had to leaf through thick newspapers just to barely see the quotations of a few companies; today a single computer can calculate every indicator of more than a thousand stocks in a few seconds, and this leap in efficiency is exactly the soil in which quantitative trading could rise.

pairs.zh: 量化的第一步是找规律。
pairs.en: The first step of quantitative trading is finding patterns.

pairs.zh: 研究者会把过去几十年的市场行情整理成密密麻麻的数据，然后去寻找那些反复出现的模式。
pairs.en: Researchers organize decades of market data into dense datasets and then look for patterns that repeat.

pairs.zh: 比如有一种很朴素的想法，认为股价短期涨得太快的往往会回头，跌得太急的往往会反弹，于是就制定规则，连续上涨几天后卖出一部分，连续下跌几天后买进一部分。
pairs.en: For example, one plain idea holds that stocks that rise too fast in the short term tend to pull back, and those that fall too sharply tend to rebound, so a rule is set to sell part after several consecutive days of rise and buy part after several consecutive days of fall.

pairs.zh: 又比如有人发现，那些经营稳定、估值不高、分红大方的公司长期来看往往跑赢大市，于是就按照市盈率、市净率、分红率这些指标，把符合条件的股票选出来组成一个篮子。
pairs.en: Another example: some people find that companies with stable operations, low valuations, and generous dividends tend to outperform the market over the long term, so they select qualifying stocks by indicators such as price-to-earnings ratio, price-to-book ratio, and dividend yield, and form them into a basket.

pairs.zh: 还有人专门盯住同一家公司股票和债券之间的价格差异，一旦出现不正常的偏离就动手，等它回到正常位置再获利了结。
pairs.en: Others specialize in the price difference between the same company's stocks and bonds, acting when an abnormal deviation appears and taking profit when it returns to normal.

pairs.zh: 也有人研究开盘前的集合竞价、每天尾盘的异动，或者大资金流入流出的痕迹，把这些细节编织成一条条可以执行的指令。
pairs.en: Some also study the call auction before the open, the anomalies at the end of each day, or the traces of large capital inflows and outflows, weaving these details into executable orders one by one.

pairs.zh: 这些想法听起来并不神秘，真正的难点在于，它们是否在足够长的时间里、在足够多的股票身上都成立，这就需要用数据反复检验。
pairs.en: These ideas do not sound mysterious; the real difficulty is whether they hold over a long enough period and across enough stocks, which requires repeated verification with data.

pairs.zh: 为了检验一个想法是否靠谱，人们会做一种叫做回测的工作。
pairs.en: To test whether an idea is sound, people do a kind of work called backtesting.

pairs.zh: 就是把这条规则放到过去的行情里，假想自己从很多年前就一直照它做，看看到底能赚多少钱、中间会经历多大的起伏。
pairs.en: It means running the rule through past market data, imagining that you have followed it for many years, and seeing how much money it would have made and how much fluctuation it would have endured along the way.

pairs.zh: 一个策略表面上赚钱不算本事，还要看它赚钱的过程是不是让人难以承受。
pairs.en: A strategy that makes money on the surface is no skill; it must also be seen whether the process of making money is bearable.

pairs.zh: 如果一年里有十个月都是亏的，最大亏损达到一半，哪怕最后算下来赚了钱，真实操作时也很少有人能坚持得住。
pairs.en: If ten months out of a year are losses and the maximum drawdown reaches half, then even if the final result is profitable, very few people could stick with it in real trading.

pairs.zh: 所以好的量化研究者不光看最终收益，还要仔细看它的回撤有多深、遇到极端行情时会不会失灵、过去赚到的钱有多少是靠一两次好运气。
pairs.en: So good quantitative researchers do not look only at final returns; they also examine closely how deep the drawdowns are, whether it fails in extreme markets, and how much of the past profits came from one or two strokes of luck.

pairs.zh: 他们还会刻意把规则放到自己没见过的那一段数据上测试，看看它是不是只对过去有效，一旦换个时间就立刻原形毕露，这种方法能有效避免把噪声错当成规律。
pairs.en: They also deliberately test the rules on data they have never seen, to see whether they work only for the past and immediately reveal their true nature in a different time period; this method effectively avoids mistaking noise for patterns.

pairs.zh: 把策略真正放到市场上运行时，电脑会不知疲倦地盯着行情，按照预设的参数下单。
pairs.en: When a strategy is truly run in the market, the computer tirelessly watches the market and places orders according to preset parameters.

pairs.zh: 它不会因为大涨而贪婪，也不会因为大跌而恐慌，这点恰恰是普通投资者最难做到的。
pairs.en: It will not be greedy because of a big rise, nor panic because of a big fall, and this is precisely the hardest thing for ordinary investors to do.

pairs.zh: 但量化绝不是稳赚不赔的神话。
pairs.en: But quantitative trading is by no means a myth of guaranteed profit.

pairs.zh: 市场在变，过去有效的规律可能因为做的人多了而渐渐消失，也可能遇到从来没有出现过的极端情况而瞬间失效。
